availableCommands.name: google-workspace
availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.

availableCommands.name: user:docs
availableCommands.description: docs (editable docs people share and comment on; the default for any document, named as a doc or not: a document, report, proposal, resume, cover letter, letter, contract, policy, form, template, worksheet, essay, handbook, guide, how-to, cheat sheet, SOP or other writing to keep, share, collaborate on, send, submit, print or sign; a doc exports to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs, so needing a file to send, attach, upload, submit or print is no reason to pick Word, and a file nobody asked for is a doc, not Word; a plan, comparison, summary or notes asked in chat stays in chat; a pasted claude.ai artifact link may be a doc: check with docs tools first; Word or another file format named, tracked changes wanted, or a .docx to change or use as a template → that format's skill): making one → if no docs-connector instructions are in context, call its `guide` (topic.instructions) first; then create the doc (headings only, no body) before any search, file read or plan, even with files attached.

# Review candidate

Read-only. Do not repair or start another review.

## Specification
### P07.2 — Tenancy без stancl: данные, provisioning, manifests

**Intent:** Убрать последний код и все следы stancl: модели `Account`/`Domain` становятся обычными Eloquent-моделями, provisioning и lifecycle работают без базовых классов и JobPipeline, config живёт под одним ключом `corex-tenancy`, а manifests, lock, скрипты, CI и PHPStan больше не знают о снимках stancl.

**Why:** D95 п.1, п.7–п.8; D16 запрещает pre-release/неопубликованные зависимости в релизных пакетах; `ALLOWED_PRERELEASE` в `scripts/manifest-check.py` — последнее исключение. Ключ `tenancy` был общим с конфигом stancl, N7 требует `corex-tenancy`.

**Scope Included:** `Account` (`extends Model`, `HasUuids`, central connection, явные fillable/casts) и `Domain` без stancl-трейтов; `HostResolverCacheInvalidator`; `TemplateClonePostgreSQLManager` без базового класса; `DatabaseTenantProvisioner`, `DatabaseTenantLifecycle`, `CreateDatabaseFromTemplate` на `AccountRef`; `EventsRegistrar` без `JobPipeline`/`TenantCreated`; `AccountTemplateSnapshot`; слияние `config/tenancy.php` в `config/corex-tenancy.php`, `TenancyOptions::fromArray(array $config)`, удаление полей stancl; удаление `StanclImportBoundaryRule`, его регистрации и тестов, `StanclIsolationTest`; перевод 13 тестов со stancl-импортами; удаление `axiomasoft/stancl-*` из root и tenancy `composer.json` и `composer.lock`, снятие `dont-discover`; `ALLOWED_PRERELEASE = {}`; удаление `scripts/distribution/stage-stancl-providers.py`, `.composer-provider-staging/` и шагов staging в workflows; правка ссылок в скриптах из `facts/stancl-coupling.txt`; docblock `TenantDatabaseLifecycle`; `configuration.md` (регенерация), tenancy README/PACKAGE/CHANGELOG; Golden delta P07.2.

**Scope Excluded:** удаление колонки `root_accounts.data` и любые миграции (P08); impersonation-порты (P07.3); `docs/03_Dev/**`, `docs/audit-*.md`; обновление других зависимостей lock.

**Inputs:** `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D100-p07-grok-design-remediation.md` · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D98-p07-design-audit-remediation.md` · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D95-p07-tenancy-engine.md` · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/research/P07-design.md` (§1.2, §2, §3.2, §4, §5) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/research/P07-design-rag.md` (W1–W2, VERIFY-AT-EXEC) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07-design/examples.md` (§1b, §5) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07-design/facts/stancl-coupling.txt` · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07-design-rag/http-01-packagist-stancl-azguard.md` · результат P07.1 (`plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07.1-execution/completion.md`, появляется после его исполнения)

**Files:** `packages/tenancy/CHANGELOG.md`, `packages/core/CHANGELOG.md`; `packages/tenancy/src/Account/Internal/Models/Account.php`; `packages/tenancy/src/DomainTrust/Internal/Models/Domain.php`; `packages/tenancy/src/Runtime/Internal/HostResolverCacheInvalidator.php` (перевести observer с временных vendor events на Eloquent); `packages/tenancy/src/Account/Internal/{StanclTenantDatabaseProvisioner→DatabaseTenantProvisioner}.php`; `packages/tenancy/src/Provisioning/Internal/{StanclTenantDatabaseLifecycle→DatabaseTenantLifecycle}.php`; `packages/tenancy/src/Provisioning/Internal/Database/TemplateClonePostgreSQLManager.php`; `packages/tenancy/src/Account/Internal/Jobs/CreateDatabaseFromTemplate.php`; `packages/tenancy/src/Account/Laravel/AccountTemplateSnapshot.php`; `packages/tenancy/src/Laravel/{EventsRegistrar,RuntimeRegistrar}.php`; `packages/tenancy/src/TenancyServiceProvider.php`; `packages/tenancy/src/Laravel/Support/TenancyOptions.php`; `packages/tenancy/config/tenancy.php` (удалить), `packages/tenancy/config/corex-tenancy.php`; `packages/tenancy/src/PHPStan/Rules/StanclImportBoundaryRule.php`, `packages/tenancy/tests/PHPStan/**stancl*`, `packages/tenancy/tests/Arch/StanclIsolationTest.php` (удалить); `packages/tenancy/extension.neon`, `packages/tenancy/phpstan-baseline.neon`; `packages/tenancy/tests/**` (файлы из `facts/stancl-coupling.txt` §tests); `packages/core/src/Context/Contracts/TenantDatabaseLifecycle.php`; `composer.json`, `packages/tenancy/composer.json`, `composer.lock`; `scripts/manifest-check.py`, `scripts/{dependency-analyser.sh,configuration-classes.json}`, CI-рецепт и BC-скрипт из `facts/stancl-coupling.txt` §non-PHP (строки staging stancl), `scripts/distribution/{stage-stancl-providers.py,pristine-proof.py,profile-proof.py,remaining-cohort-policy.json,tests/test_publish_guard.py}`, `.composer-provider-staging/**`; `.github/workflows/{ci,distribution-proof,remaining-cohort-proof}.yml`; `docs/architecture/configuration.md`; `packages/tenancy/{README,PACKAGE}.md`; `packages/tenancy/resources/contracts/php-api.json`; `tests/Golden/baseline/*` (строки P07.2 из §4); `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07.2-execution/**`.

**Required Reads:** 1) `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/research/P07-design.md` §1.2, §3.2, §5 (F4, F5); 2) `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/research/P07-design-rag.md` (VERIFY-AT-EXEC); 3) `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07-design/facts/stancl-coupling.txt`; 4) `packages/tenancy/src/Account/Internal/Models/Account.php`; 5) `packages/tenancy/src/Provisioning/Internal/Database/TemplateClonePostgreSQLManager.php`; 6) `packages/tenancy/src/Laravel/EventsRegistrar.php`; 7) `packages/tenancy/src/Laravel/Support/TenancyOptions.php`; 8) `scripts/manifest-check.py`.

**Implementation Rules:** VERIFY-AT-EXEC — первый шаг; стабильный stancl v4 → стоп (F5). Удалить временные model/provisioning проекции и UUID binding из P07.1, инвалидация cache — теперь plain Eloquent events. Без алиасов и мостов (D01): старые классы и config-ключ `tenancy` удаляются, все ссылки правятся. Lock меняется только удалением stancl-пакетов (F4). Поведение provisioning сохраняется (синхронное создание базы из шаблона, проверка целостности шаблона). Колонка `data` не читается и не пишется. phpstan baseline только сокращается. Manifest и changelog — в одном продуктовом commit; base SHA — до правок.

**Code Guidance:** Досье §3.2 шаги 1–10; examples §1b (central + `db_name`), §5 (инвалидация кэша host). Список ссылок пересобирается `bash plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07-design/scripts/p07-facts.sh /tmp/p07-facts`.

**Validation:**
- После продуктового commit: `bash scripts/contract-guard.sh` и `bash scripts/contract-guard.sh "$(cat plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07.2-execution/base-commit.txt)"` → exit 0.
- VERIFY-AT-EXEC → нет `v4*` (запись в Completion Notes).
- `git grep -n -i stancl -- packages products scripts .github composer.json ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` → пусто; `test ! -e .composer-provider-staging` → exit 0; `python3 -c "import json;l=json.load(open('composer.lock'));print([p['name'] for p in l['packages']+l['packages-dev'] if 'stancl' in p['name']])"` → `[]`; `git diff "$(cat plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07.2-execution/base-commit.txt)" -- composer.lock` удаляет только пакеты, перечисленные в Completion Notes с выводом `composer why`.
- `scripts/php84 composer manifests:check` → exit 0 при `ALLOWED_PRERELEASE = {}`; негатив: временно вернуть `"axiomasoft/stancl-tenancy": ">=4.0.0-alpha1 <=4.0.0-alpha1"` в `packages/tenancy/composer.json` → exit ≠ 0 (`prerelease`), вернуть.
- `scripts/php84 composer --working-dir=packages/tenancy test`, `PGSQL_PORT=5434 scripts/php84 composer --working-dir=packages/tenancy test -- --group=pg` → exit 0 (provisioning из шаблона, lifecycle export/drop, host resolution с инвалидацией).
- `scripts/php84 composer config-cache-check`, `scripts/php84 composer configuration-reference` → exit 0, `docs/architecture/configuration.md` без ключа `tenancy.` и без stancl.
- `scripts/php84 composer test:packages`, `PGSQL_PORT=5434 scripts/php84 composer test:pg`, `scripts/php84 composer test:arch` → exit 0.
- `scripts/php84 php scripts/php-api.php --write` дважды → идентично; `scripts/php84 composer php-api`, `scripts/php84 composer bc-check` → exit 0; diff Golden — только строки P07.2 из досье §4.
- `scripts/php84 composer lint:check`, `scripts/php84 composer analyse`, `scripts/php84 composer deps:analyse` → exit 0; `bash scripts/anti-weakening-gate.sh` → exit 0; `php scripts/package-docs-gate.php` → exit 0.
- Review `light` (D97): self-check по досье §6; строка `review: self-check GREEN` в Completion Notes.

**Deliverables:** package changelogs; `artifacts/P07.2-execution/base-commit.txt` и candidate SHA; tenancy без stancl во всех слоях; пустой `ALLOWED_PRERELEASE`; один config-ключ `corex-tenancy`; Golden delta P07.2; `artifacts/P07.2-execution/completion.md`.

### P07.2 — Tenancy без stancl: данные, provisioning, manifests

**Intent:** Убрать последний код и все следы stancl: модели `Account`/`Domain` становятся обычными Eloquent-моделями, provisioning и lifecycle работают без базовых классов и JobPipeline, config живёт под одним ключом `corex-tenancy`, а manifests, lock, скрипты, CI и PHPStan больше не знают о снимках stancl.

**Why:** D95 п.1, п.7–п.8; D16 запрещает pre-release/неопубликованные зависимости в релизных пакетах; `ALLOWED_PRERELEASE` в `scripts/manifest-check.py` — последнее исключение. Ключ `tenancy` был общим с конфигом stancl, N7 требует `corex-tenancy`.

**Scope Included:** `Account` (`extends Model`, `HasUuids`, central connection, явные fillable/casts) и `Domain` без stancl-трейтов; `HostResolverCacheInvalidator`; `TemplateClonePostgreSQLManager` без базового класса; `DatabaseTenantProvisioner`, `DatabaseTenantLifecycle`, `CreateDatabaseFromTemplate` на `AccountRef`; `EventsRegistrar` без `JobPipeline`/`TenantCreated`; `AccountTemplateSnapshot`; слияние `config/tenancy.php` в `config/corex-tenancy.php`, `TenancyOptions::fromArray(array $config)`, удаление полей stancl; удаление `StanclImportBoundaryRule`, его регистрации и тестов, `StanclIsolationTest`; перевод 13 тестов со stancl-импортами; удаление `axiomasoft/stancl-*` из root и tenancy `composer.json` и `composer.lock`, снятие `dont-discover`; `ALLOWED_PRERELEASE = {}`; удаление `scripts/distribution/stage-stancl-providers.py`, `.composer-provider-staging/` и шагов staging в workflows; правка ссылок в скриптах из `facts/stancl-coupling.txt`; docblock `TenantDatabaseLifecycle`; `configuration.md` (регенерация), tenancy README/PACKAGE/CHANGELOG; Golden delta P07.2.

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel;

use CoreX\Attributes\Spi;
use CoreX\Attributes\SpiKind;
use CoreX\Modules\Contracts\PackageRegistrar;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Internal\Models\Account;
use CoreX\Tenancy\DomainTrust\Internal\Models\Domain;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Internal\ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\HostResolverCacheInvalidator;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\TenancyOptions;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal\QueueTenantContext;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Events\Dispatcher;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Queue\Events\JobAttempted;
use Illuminate\Queue\Events\JobProcessing;
use Override;

#[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]
final class EventsRegistrar implements PackageRegistrar
{
    #[Override]
    public function register(Application $app): void {}

    #[Override]
    public function boot(Application $app): void
    {
        $options = $app->make(TenancyOptions::class);
        $events = $app->make(Dispatcher::class);

        // Resolved from the container per event: QueueTenantContext is a singleton frame stack.
        // JobAttempted (dispatched from the `finally` of Worker::process and SyncQueue::executeJob)
        // is the only point that ends a job's context.
        $events->listen(JobProcessing::class, [QueueTenantContext::class, 'processing']);
        $events->listen(JobAttempted::class, [QueueTenantContext::class, 'finished']);

        // Host → account entries are forgotten before a model's rows go away, and after any save.
        // The invalidator itself is a no-op while host identification or its cache is off.
        $events->listen('eloquent.saved: '.Account::class, [HostResolverCacheInvalidator::class, 'accountChanged']);
        $events->listen('eloquent.deleting: '.Account::class, [HostResolverCacheInvalidator::class, 'accountChanged']);
        $events->listen('eloquent.saved: '.Domain::class, [HostResolverCacheInvalidator::class, 'domainChanged']);
        $events->listen('eloquent.deleting: '.Domain::class, [HostResolverCacheInvalidator::class, 'domainChanged']);

        // Wildcard listeners stay inside the OIDC block: impersonation can be
        // configured while OIDC is off, and that profile registers nothing.
        if ($options->oidcEnabled && $options->impersonation->enabled) {
            // Resolve per event. A captured instance would keep the first
            // request's scoped impersonation service in a long-lived worker.
            $events->listen('eloquent.saving: *', [ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard::class, 'handle']);
            $events->listen('eloquent.deleting: *', [ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard::class, 'handle']);
            $events->listen('eloquent.restoring: *', [ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard::class, 'handle']);
        }
    }
}

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Internal\Database;

use CoreX\Context\Data\AccountRef;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Laravel\AccountTemplateSnapshot;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\TenancyOptions;
use Illuminate\Database\Connection;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use RuntimeException;
use Throwable;

/**
 * `CREATE DATABASE … TEMPLATE "tpl_v42" STRATEGY WAL_LOG` (golden-clone
 * provisioning) — `tpl_v42`
 * here is only an illustrative name; the real template name is read from
 * `root_templates.db_name`. `STRATEGY WAL_LOG` is mandatory — PG15+
 * defaults `CREATE DATABASE … TEMPLATE` to FILE_COPY, far slower for a
 * populated golden template.
 *
 * Template-parity gate: refuses to clone a template whose
 * `root_templates.status` isn't `ready` — the FROZEN DB_SCHEMA contract
 * carries no schema-hash column, so `status` is the only available parity
 * signal.
 *
 * Quarantine handling: PG rejects `CREATE DATABASE … TEMPLATE` while any
 * backend is connected to the template DB (SQLSTATE 55006 — "source
 * database is being accessed by other users"). The golden template is
 * never meant to have live connections; this is a defensive pre-step +
 * bounded retry, not a substitute for that invariant.
 *
 * @internal spec: D24, premortem A3/B3, R-11 §2.3 п.2, F-DDL1
 */
final class TemplateClonePostgreSQLManager
{
    private const int QUARANTINE_RETRIES = 5;

    private const int QUARANTINE_BACKOFF_MS = 200;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly TenancyOptions $options,
        private readonly ConnectionResolverInterface $connections,
        private readonly TemplateIntegrityVerifier $integrity,
    ) {}

    public function createForAccount(AccountRef $account): bool
    {
        $snapshot = AccountTemplateSnapshot::capture($account, $this->centralConnection());

        $this->integrity->assertCurrent(
            version: $snapshot->templateVersion,
            clusterId: $snapshot->clusterId,
        );

        $name = $snapshot->databaseName;
        $this->validateParameter($name);

        $template = $this->resolveReadyTemplate($snapshot->templateVersion);
        $this->validateParameter($template);

        $cluster = $this->resolveCluster($snapshot->clusterId);
        $this->validateParameter($cluster);

        $created = $this->createDatabase($name, $template);

        $this->connection()->statement("GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE \"{$name}\" TO \"{$cluster}\"");
        $this->connection()->statement("ALTER DATABASE \"{$name}\" OWNER TO \"{$cluster}\"");

        return $created;
    }

    public function createDatabase(string $name, string $templateDbName): bool
    {
        $this->validateParameter($name);
        $this->validateParameter($templateDbName);
        for ($attempt = 1; $attempt <= self::QUARANTINE_RETRIES; $attempt++) {
            $this->terminateTemplateBackends($templateDbName);

            try {
                return $this->connection()->statement(
                    "CREATE DATABASE \"{$name}\" TEMPLATE \"{$templateDbName}\" STRATEGY WAL_LOG",
                );
            } catch (Throwable $e) {
                $isQuarantined = str_contains($e->getMessage(), '55006')
                    || str_contains($e->getMessage(), 'is being accessed by other users');

                if (! $isQuarantined || $attempt === self::QUARANTINE_RETRIES) {
                    throw $e;
                }

                usleep(self::QUARANTINE_BACKOFF_MS * 1000 * $attempt);
            }
        }

        throw new RuntimeException("Unreachable: template clone retries exhausted for [{$templateDbName}].");
    }

    private function terminateTemplateBackends(string $templateDbName): void
    {
        $this->connection()->statement(
            'SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = ? AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()',
            [$templateDbName],
        );
    }

    private function resolveReadyTemplate(int $version): string
    {
        $template = $this->connections->connection($this->centralConnection())
            ->table('root_templates')
            ->where('version', $version)
            ->first();

        if ($template === null || $template->status !== 'ready' || ! is_string($template->db_name)) {
            throw new RuntimeException(
                "Template version [{$version}] is not ready for cloning (template-parity gate, D24).",
            );
        }

        return $template->db_name;
    }

    private function resolveCluster(string $clusterId): string
    {
        $cluster = $this->connections->connection($this->centralConnection())
            ->table('root_clusters')
            ->where('id', $clusterId)
            ->first();

        if ($cluster === null || ! is_string($cluster->app_db_user)) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Cluster [{$clusterId}] not found in root_clusters.");
        }

        return $cluster->app_db_user;
    }

    public function deleteDatabase(string $name): bool
    {
        $this->validateParameter($name);

        return $this->connection()->statement('DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS "'.$name.'"');
    }

    public function databaseExists(string $name): bool
    {
        return $this->connection()->selectOne('SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datname = ?', [$name]) !== null;
    }

    private function validateParameter(string $value): void
    {
        if (preg_match('/\A[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\z/D', $value) !== 1 || strlen($value) > 63) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Invalid PostgreSQL database or role identifier.');
        }
    }

    private function connection(): Connection
    {
        /** @var Connection */
        $connection = $this->connections->connection($this->centralConnection());

        return $connection;
    }

    private function centralConnection(): string
    {
        return $this->options->centralConnection;
    }
}

        public string $storageDurableRoot,
        public string $storageEphemeralRoot,
        public bool $hostIdentificationEnabled,
        public bool $hostCache,
        public int $hostCacheTtl,
        public ?string $hostCacheStore,
        public bool $domainTrustEnabled,
        public int $domainTrustChallengeTtlSeconds,
        public StatusGatePolicy $statusGate,
        public bool $oidcEnabled,
        public ?string $oidcIssuer,
        public ?string $oidcClientId,
        public ?SecretRef $oidcClientSecret,
        public ?string $oidcRedirectUri,
        public array $oidcAllowedAlgs,
        public int $oidcLeewaySeconds,
        public string $oidcGuard,
        public ?string $oidcDiscoveryCacheStore,
        public int $oidcDiscoveryCacheTtl,
        public ?string $oidcJwksCacheStore,
        public int $oidcJwksCacheTtl,
        public int $oidcJwksRefetchCooldownSeconds,
        public ImpersonationPolicy $impersonation,
        public int $oidcMaxSessionLifetimeMinutes,
        public ?string $workspacePathSegment,
        public AccountLifecyclePolicy $lifecycle,
        public string $wakeupDriver,
        public string $wakeupRootConnection,
        public int $wakeupLeaseSeconds,
        public array $templateIntegrityTrustedKeys,
        public array $templateIntegrityManifests,
        public string $membershipGuard,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $config
     */
    public static function fromArray(array $config): self
    {
        $violations = new ConfigurationValidator;

        $centralConnection = self::nonEmpty($violations, 'central_connection', $config['central_connection'] ?? 'pgsql');
        $bootstrappers = self::bootstrappers($violations, $config['bootstrappers'] ?? null);

        $cachePrefix = self::nonEmpty($violations, 'cache_prefix', $config['cache_prefix'] ?? 'tenant_%tenant%_');

        if (! str_contains($cachePrefix, '%tenant%')) {
            $violations->add('corex-tenancy.cache_prefix', 'must contain %tenant%');
        }

        $cacheStores = self::cacheStores($violations, $config['cache_stores'] ?? []);

        $storage = is_array($config['storage'] ?? null) ? $config['storage'] : [];
        $storageDurableDriver = self::nonEmpty(
            $violations,
            'storage.durable_driver',
            $storage['durable_driver'] ?? 'local',
        );
        $storageDurableRoot = self::nonEmpty(
            $violations,
            'storage.durable_root',
            $storage['durable_root'] ?? 'storage/app/corex/tenancy-durable',
        );
        $storageEphemeralRoot = self::nonEmpty(
            $violations,
            'storage.ephemeral_root',
            $storage['ephemeral_root'] ?? 'storage/app/corex/tenancy-ephemeral',
        );

        $hostIdentification = is_array($config['host_identification'] ?? null)
            ? $config['host_identification']
            : [];
        $hostIdentificationEnabled = self::bool(
            $violations,
            'host_identification.enabled',
            $hostIdentification['enabled'] ?? false,
        );
        $hostCache = self::bool(
            $violations,
            'host_identification.cache',
            $hostIdentification['cache'] ?? true,
        );
        $hostCacheTtl = self::nonNegativeInt(
            $violations,
            'host_identification.cache_ttl',
            $hostIdentification['cache_ttl'] ?? 300,
        );
        $hostCacheStore = self::nullableNonEmptyString(
            $hostIdentification['cache_store'] ?? null,
        );

        // Host lookups run before any account context and must stay central: the host store is
        // never one of the per-account (prefixed) stores.
        if ($hostCacheStore !== null && in_array($hostCacheStore, $cacheStores, true)) {
            $violations->add('corex-tenancy.host_identification.cache_store', 'must not be one of cache_stores');
        }

        $domainTrust = is_array($config['domain_trust'] ?? null) ? $config['domain_trust'] : [];
        $domainTrustEnabled = self::bool($violations, 'domain_trust.enabled', $domainTrust['enabled'] ?? false);
        $domainTrustChallengeTtlSeconds = self::positiveInt(
            $violations,
            'domain_trust.challenge_ttl_seconds',
            $domainTrust['challenge_ttl_seconds'] ?? 300,
        );

        $statusGate = self::statusGate($violations, $config);

        $oidc = is_array($config['oidc'] ?? null) ? $config['oidc'] : [];
        $oidcEnabled = self::bool($violations, 'oidc.enabled', $oidc['enabled'] ?? false);
        $oidcIssuer = self::nullableNonEmptyString($oidc['issuer'] ?? null);
        $oidcClientId = self::nullableNonEmptyString($oidc['client_id'] ?? null);
        $oidcClientSecret = self::optionalSecret($violations, 'oidc.client_secret', $oidc['client_secret'] ?? null);
        $oidcRedirectUri = self::nullableNonEmptyString($oidc['redirect_uri'] ?? null);
        $oidcAllowedAlgs = self::stringList($oidc['allowed_algs'] ?? ['RS256']);
        $oidcLeewaySeconds = self::nonNegativeInt($violations, 'oidc.leeway_seconds', $oidc['leeway_seconds'] ?? 30);
        $oidcGuard = self::nonEmpty($violations, 'oidc.guard', $oidc['guard'] ?? 'web');

        $discovery = is_array($oidc['discovery'] ?? null) ? $oidc['discovery'] : [];
        $oidcDiscoveryCacheStore = self::nullableNonEmptyString($discovery['cache_store'] ?? null);
        $oidcDiscoveryCacheTtl = self::positiveInt(
            $violations,
            'oidc.discovery.cache_ttl',
            $discovery['cache_ttl'] ?? 3600,
        );

        $jwks = is_array($oidc['jwks'] ?? null) ? $oidc['jwks'] : [];
        $oidcJwksCacheStore = self::nullableNonEmptyString($jwks['cache_store'] ?? null);
        $oidcJwksCacheTtl = self::positiveInt($violations, 'oidc.jwks.cache_ttl', $jwks['cache_ttl'] ?? 3600);
        $oidcJwksRefetchCooldownSeconds = self::positiveInt(
            $violations,
            'oidc.jwks.refetch_cooldown_seconds',
            $jwks['refetch_cooldown_seconds'] ?? 60,
        );

        $impersonationConfig = is_array($oidc['impersonation'] ?? null) ? $oidc['impersonation'] : [];
        $impersonation = new ImpersonationPolicy(
            enabled: self::bool($violations, 'oidc.impersonation.enabled', $impersonationConfig['enabled'] ?? false),
            requireApprovedBy: self::bool(
                $violations,
                'oidc.impersonation.require_approved_by',
                $impersonationConfig['require_approved_by'] ?? false,
            ),
        );

        $oidcMaxSessionLifetimeMinutes = self::positiveInt(
            $violations,
            'oidc.max_session_lifetime_minutes',
            $oidc['max_session_lifetime_minutes'] ?? 720,
        );

        if ($oidcEnabled) {
            if ($oidcIssuer === null) {
                $violations->add('oidc.issuer', 'must be non-empty when oidc.enabled is true');
            }

            if ($oidcClientId === null) {
                $violations->add('oidc.client_id', 'must be non-empty when oidc.enabled is true');
            }

            if ($oidcRedirectUri === null) {
                $violations->add('oidc.redirect_uri', 'must be non-empty when oidc.enabled is true');
            }

            if ($oidcClientSecret === null || ! $oidcClientSecret->isPresent()) {
                $violations->add('oidc.client_secret', 'must be present when oidc.enabled is true');
            }

            if ($oidcAllowedAlgs === []) {
                $violations->add('oidc.allowed_algs', 'must not be empty when oidc.enabled is true');
            }
        }

        $workspace = is_array($config['workspace'] ?? null) ? $config['workspace'] : [];
        $workspacePathSegment = self::nullableNonEmptyString($workspace['path_segment'] ?? 'w');

        $lifecycle = new AccountLifecyclePolicy(
            trialDays: self::nonNegativeInt($violations, 'trial_days', $config['trial_days'] ?? 14),
            graceDays: self::nonNegativeInt($violations, 'grace_days', $config['grace_days'] ?? 30),
            platformDomain: self::nonEmpty($violations, 'platform_domain', $config['platform_domain'] ?? 'example.test'),
        );

        $wakeup = is_array($config['wakeup'] ?? null) ? $config['wakeup'] : [];
        $wakeupDriver = is_string($wakeup['driver'] ?? null) ? $wakeup['driver'] : 'local_sweep';

        if (! in_array($wakeupDriver, ['local_sweep', 'root_registry'], true)) {
            $violations->add('wakeup.driver', 'must be local_sweep or root_registry');
            $wakeupDriver = 'local_sweep';
        }

        $wakeupRootConnection = is_string($wakeup['root_connection'] ?? null)
            ? $wakeup['root_connection']
            : '';

        if ($wakeupDriver === 'root_registry' && $wakeupRootConnection === '') {
            $violations->add('wakeup.root_connection', 'must be non-empty when wakeup.driver is root_registry');
        }

        $wakeupLeaseSeconds = self::positiveInt($violations, 'wakeup.lease_seconds', $wakeup['lease_seconds'] ?? 60);

        $templateIntegrity = is_array($config['template_integrity'] ?? null)
            ? $config['template_integrity']
            : [];
        $templateIntegrityTrustedKeys = self::stringMap($templateIntegrity['trusted_keys'] ?? []);
        $templateIntegrityManifests = self::arrayMap($templateIntegrity['manifests'] ?? []);

        $membershipGuardConfig = is_array($config['membership_guard'] ?? null)
            ? $config['membership_guard']
            : [];
        $membershipGuard = self::nonEmpty(
            $violations,
            'membership_guard.guard',
            $membershipGuardConfig['guard'] ?? 'web',
        );

        $violations->failIfAny();

        return new self(
            centralConnection: $centralConnection,
            bootstrappers: $bootstrappers,
            cachePrefix: $cachePrefix,
            cacheStores: $cacheStores,
            storageDurableDriver: $storageDurableDriver,
            storageDurableRoot: $storageDurableRoot,
            storageEphemeralRoot: $storageEphemeralRoot,
            hostIdentificationEnabled: $hostIdentificationEnabled,
            hostCache: $hostCache,
            hostCacheTtl: $hostCacheTtl,
            hostCacheStore: $hostCacheStore,
            domainTrustEnabled: $domainTrustEnabled,
            domainTrustChallengeTtlSeconds: $domainTrustChallengeTtlSeconds,
            statusGate: $statusGate,
            oidcEnabled: $oidcEnabled,
            oidcIssuer: $oidcIssuer,
            oidcClientId: $oidcClientId,
            oidcClientSecret: $oidcClientSecret,
            oidcRedirectUri: $oidcRedirectUri,
            oidcAllowedAlgs: $oidcAllowedAlgs,
            oidcLeewaySeconds: $oidcLeewaySeconds,
            oidcGuard: $oidcGuard,
            oidcDiscoveryCacheStore: $oidcDiscoveryCacheStore,
            oidcDiscoveryCacheTtl: $oidcDiscoveryCacheTtl,
            oidcJwksCacheStore: $oidcJwksCacheStore,
            oidcJwksCacheTtl: $oidcJwksCacheTtl,
            oidcJwksRefetchCooldownSeconds: $oidcJwksRefetchCooldownSeconds,
            impersonation: $impersonation,
            oidcMaxSessionLifetimeMinutes: $oidcMaxSessionLifetimeMinutes,
            workspacePathSegment: $workspacePathSegment,
            lifecycle: $lifecycle,
            wakeupDriver: $wakeupDriver,
            wakeupRootConnection: $wakeupRootConnection,
            wakeupLeaseSeconds: $wakeupLeaseSeconds,
            templateIntegrityTrustedKeys: $templateIntegrityTrustedKeys,
            templateIntegrityManifests: $templateIntegrityManifests,
            membershipGuard: $membershipGuard,
        );
    }

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $config */
    private static function statusGate(ConfigurationValidator $violations, array $config): StatusGatePolicy
    {
        $statusGate = is_array($config['status_gate'] ?? null) ? $config['status_gate'] : [];
        $paymentRoute = self::nullableNonEmptyString($statusGate['payment_route'] ?? null);
        $exportRoute = self::nullableNonEmptyString($statusGate['export_route'] ?? null);
        $methods = self::stringList($statusGate['read_only_methods'] ?? ['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS']);
        $normalized = array_values(array_unique(array_map(
            static fn (string $method): string => strtoupper($method),
            $methods,
        )));

        if ($normalized === []) {
            $violations->add('status_gate.read_only_methods', 'must not be empty');
            $normalized = ['GET'];
        }

        return new StatusGatePolicy(
            paymentRoute: $paymentRoute,
            exportRoute: $exportRoute,
            readOnlyMethods: $normalized,
        );
    }

    /**
     * Closed order: the stock bootstrappers keep their relative order with the connection one
     * first and exactly once; host-supplied bootstrappers may follow, never precede.
     *
     * @return list<class-string<TenantBootstrapper>>
     */
    private static function bootstrappers(ConfigurationValidator $violations, mixed $value): array
    {
        $value ??= [
            ConnectionBootstrapper::class,
            CachePrefixBootstrapper::class,
            SessionConnectionBootstrapper::class,
        ];

        if (! is_array($value) || $value === []) {
            $violations->add('corex-tenancy.bootstrappers', 'must be a non-empty list of class names');

            return [];
        }

        $stock = [ConnectionBootstrapper::class, CachePrefixBootstrapper::class, SessionConnectionBootstrapper::class];
        $resolved = [];
        $lastStock = -1;
        $hostSeen = false;

        foreach (array_values($value) as $index => $class) {
            $path = 'corex-tenancy.bootstrappers.'.$index;

            if (! is_string($class) || ! class_exists($class) || ! is_a($class, TenantBootstrapper::class, true)) {
                $violations->add($path, 'must be an existing class implementing '.TenantBootstrapper::class);

                continue;
            }

            if (in_array($class, $resolved, true)) {
                $violations->add($path, 'must not be listed twice');

                continue;
            }

            $position = array_search($class, $stock, true);

            if ($position === false) {
                $hostSeen = true;
            } elseif ($hostSeen || $position < $lastStock) {
                $violations->add($path, 'stock bootstrappers must keep their order and precede host bootstrappers');
            } else {
                $lastStock = $position;
            }

            $resolved[] = $class;
        }

        if (($resolved[0] ?? null) !== ConnectionBootstrapper::class) {
            $violations->add('corex-tenancy.bootstrappers.0', ConnectionBootstrapper::class.' must come first');
        }

        return $resolved;
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    private static function cacheStores(ConfigurationValidator $violations, mixed $value): array
    {
        if (! is_array($value)) {
            $violations->add('corex-tenancy.cache_stores', 'must be a list of cache store names');

            return [];
        }

        $stores = [];

        foreach (array_values($value) as $index => $store) {
            if (! is_string($store) || $store === '') {
                $violations->add('corex-tenancy.cache_stores.'.$index, 'must be a non-empty store name');

                continue;
            }

            if (in_array($store, $stores, true)) {
                $violations->add('corex-tenancy.cache_stores.'.$index, 'must be unique');

                continue;
            }

            $stores[] = $store;
        }

        return $stores;
    }

    private static function optionalSecret(ConfigurationValidator $violations, string $path, mixed $value): ?SecretRef
    {
        if ($value === null || $value === '') {
            return null;
        }

        if (is_string($value)) {
            return new SecretRef($value);
        }

        $violations->add($path, 'must be a string or null');

        return null;
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    private static function stringList(mixed $value): array
    {
        if (! is_array($value)) {
            return [];
        }

        $resolved = [];

        foreach ($value as $item) {
            if (is_string($item) && $item !== '') {
                $resolved[] = $item;
            }
        }

        return $resolved;
    }

    /** @return array<string, string> */
    private static function stringMap(mixed $value): array
    {
        if (! is_array($value)) {
            return [];
        }

        $resolved = [];

        foreach ($value as $key => $item) {
            if (is_string($key) && $key !== '' && is_string($item) && $item !== '') {
                $resolved[$key] = $item;
            }
        }

        return $resolved;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    private static function arrayMap(mixed $value): array
    {
        if (! is_array($value)) {
            return [];
        }

        $resolved = [];

        foreach ($value as $key => $item) {
            if (is_string($key) && $key !== '' && is_array($item)) {
                $resolved[$key] = $item;
            }
        }

        return $resolved;
    }

    private static function bool(ConfigurationValidator $violations, string $path, mixed $value): bool
    {
        if (is_bool($value)) {
            return $value;
        }

        $violations->add($path, 'must be a boolean');

        return false;
    }

    private static function nonEmpty(ConfigurationValidator $violations, string $path, mixed $value): string
    {
        if (is_string($value) && $value !== '') {
            return $value;
        }

        $violations->add($path, 'must be a non-empty string');

        return 'invalid';
    }

    private static function nullableNonEmptyString(mixed $value): ?string
    {
        return is_string($value) && $value !== '' ? $value : null;
    }

    private static function nonNegativeInt(ConfigurationValidator $violations, string $path, mixed $value): int
    {
        if (is_int($value) && $value >= 0) {
            return $value;
        }

        $violations->add($path, 'must be a non-negative integer');

        return 0;
    }

    private static function positiveInt(ConfigurationValidator $violations, string $path, mixed $value): int
    {
        if (is_int($value) && $value > 0) {
            return $value;
        }

        $violations->add($path, 'must be a positive integer');

        return 1;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support;

use CoreX\Attributes\Spi;
use CoreX\Attributes\SpiKind;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal\HostAccountResolver;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Cache\Factory as CacheFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

/**
 * @corex-model-extension Observes saved/deleting of the Account and Domain models; reads the Domain `host` and the Account key.
 *
 * Forgets cached host → account mappings. Wired as `saved`/`deleting` listener of the
 * Account and Domain models and called by lifecycle transitions after commit.
 */
#[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]
final readonly class HostResolverCacheInvalidator
{
    public function __construct(
        private ConnectionResolverInterface $connections,
        private CacheFactory $cache,
        private TenancyOptions $options,
    ) {}

    /** A domain row changed: its current and its previous host stop resolving from cache. */
    public function domainChanged(Model $domain): void
    {
        if (! $this->enabled()) {
            return;
        }

        foreach ([$domain->getAttribute('host'), $domain->getOriginal('host')] as $host) {
            if (is_string($host) && $host !== '') {
                $this->forgetHost($host);
            }
        }
    }

    /** An account row changed: every host of the account (soft-deleted rows included) is forgotten. */
    public function accountChanged(Model $account): void
    {
        $key = $account->getKey();

        if (is_string($key) || is_int($key)) {
            $this->forgetAccount((string) $key);
        }
    }

    public function forgetAccount(string $accountId): void
    {
        if (! $this->enabled()) {
            return;
        }

        $hosts = $this->connections->connection($this->options->centralConnection)
            ->table('root_domains')->where('account_id', $accountId)->pluck('host');

        foreach ($hosts as $host) {
            if (is_string($host)) {
                $this->forgetHost($host);
            }
        }
    }

    private function enabled(): bool
    {
        return $this->options->hostIdentificationEnabled && $this->options->hostCache;
    }

    private function forgetHost(string $host): void
    {
        $this->cache->store($this->options->hostCacheStore)
            ->forget(HostAccountResolver::key(strtolower($host)));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Internal\Jobs;

use CoreX\Context\Data\AccountRef;
use CoreX\Context\Data\ProvisionParams;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Laravel\AccountTemplateSnapshot;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\TenancyOptions;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Contracts\TemplateIntegrityChecks as TemplateIntegrityVerifier;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Internal\Database\TemplateClonePostgreSQLManager;
use Illuminate\Bus\Queueable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\ShouldQueue;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Bus\Dispatchable;
use Illuminate\Queue\InteractsWithQueue;
use Illuminate\Queue\SerializesModels;

/** Synchronous, idempotent golden-template clone; never runs migrations or seeders. */
final class CreateDatabaseFromTemplate implements ShouldQueue
{
    use Dispatchable;
    use InteractsWithQueue;
    use Queueable;
    use SerializesModels;

    public function __construct(
        public readonly AccountRef $account,
        public readonly ProvisionParams $params,
    ) {}

    public function handle(
        TemplateIntegrityVerifier $templateIntegrityVerifier,
        TenancyOptions $options,
        TemplateClonePostgreSQLManager $manager,
    ): bool {
        $snapshot = AccountTemplateSnapshot::capture($this->account, $options->centralConnection);

        $templateIntegrityVerifier->verifyCurrent(
            version: $snapshot->templateVersion,
            clusterId: $snapshot->clusterId,
        );

        $name = $snapshot->databaseName;

        if ($manager->databaseExists($name)) {
            $templateIntegrityVerifier->verifyAccount($snapshot);

            return true;
        }

        return $manager->createForAccount($this->account);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Internal;

use Closure;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\TenantDatabaseLifecycle;
use CoreX\Context\Data\AccountRef;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Events\AccountPurged;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Events\ExportReady;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Events\Dispatcher;
use Illuminate\Database\Connection;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Psr\Clock\ClockInterface;
use RuntimeException;

/**
 * `export()`/`drop()` on the physical account database (B-11 §5.1/§7.3,
 * D13/AC-7, P2.12). `drop()` mirrors the `DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS` pattern
 * already used by {@see PendingPool::clearPending()}.
 *
 * The host supplies a writer that returns a durable archive path and size.
 * Every writer must supply a verifier binding readable bytes, size, content
 * digest and tenant ownership to a trusted durable archive manifest. Size
 * alone never authorizes ready or DROP, including local archives.
 */
final class DatabaseTenantLifecycle implements TenantDatabaseLifecycle
{
    /**
     * @param  Closure(AccountRef, string):array{storage_path: string, size_bytes: int}|null  $writer
     * @param  (Closure(string, int): bool)|null  $verifier
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly string $centralConnection,
        private readonly ConnectionResolverInterface $connections,
        private readonly ClockInterface $clock,
        private readonly Dispatcher $events,
        private readonly ?Closure $writer = null,
        private readonly ?Closure $verifier = null,
    ) {}

    public function export(AccountRef $account, string $kind): string
    {
        if ($this->writer === null) {
            throw new RuntimeException('No tenant export writer configured; refusing to create a ready export.');
        }
        $this->archiveVerifier();

        $exportId = (string) Str::uuid7();

        $this->db()->table('root_account_exports')->insert([
            'id' => $exportId,
            'account_id' => $account->id,
            'kind' => $kind,
            'status' => 'pending',
            'formats' => json_encode(['pg_dump', 'csv'], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR),
            'purge_after' => $this->clock->now()->modify('+30 days'),
            'url_expires_at' => $this->clock->now()->modify('+14 days'),
            'created_at' => $this->clock->now(),
            'updated_at' => $this->clock->now(),
        ]);

        $this->db()->table('root_account_exports')
            ->where('id', $exportId)
            ->update(['status' => 'running', 'updated_at' => $this->clock->now()]);

        $writer = $this->writer;
        $result = $writer($account, $exportId);
        $this->verifyArchive($result['storage_path'], $result['size_bytes']);

        $this->db()->table('root_account_exports')
            ->where('id', $exportId)
            ->update([
                'status' => 'ready',
                'storage_path' => $result['storage_path'],
                'size_bytes' => $result['size_bytes'],
                'updated_at' => $this->clock->now(),
            ]);

        $this->events->dispatch(new ExportReady(account: $account, exportId: $exportId));

        return $exportId;
    }

    public function drop(AccountRef $account): void
    {
        $latestExport = $this->db()->table('root_account_exports')
            ->where('account_id', $account->id)
            ->orderByDesc('created_at')
            ->orderByDesc('id')
            ->first();

        if ($latestExport === null || $latestExport->status !== 'ready') {
            throw new RuntimeException(
                "Refusing to drop account [{$account->id}]'s database: no ready export on record (export-before-DROP invariant, D13/AC-7).",
            );
        }

        $this->verifyArchive((string) $latestExport->storage_path, (int) $latestExport->size_bytes);

        $dbName = $this->db()->table('root_accounts')
            ->where('id', $account->id)
            ->value('db_name');

        if (! is_string($dbName) || ! preg_match('/\Aacc_[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\z/D', $dbName)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Invalid account database name; refusing DROP.');
        }

        $this->db()->statement('DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS "'.$dbName.'"');

        $this->events->dispatch(new AccountPurged($account));
    }

    private function verifyArchive(string $path, int $size): void
    {
        $verifier = $this->archiveVerifier();
        $verified = $path !== '' && $size > 0 && $verifier($path, $size);

        if (! $verified) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Tenant export archive is unavailable or has an invalid size; refusing ready/DROP.');
        }
    }

    private function archiveVerifier(): Closure
    {
        return $this->verifier ?? throw new RuntimeException('A qualified tenant archive integrity verifier is required; refusing ready/DROP.');
    }

    private function db(): Connection
    {
        /** @var Connection */
        $connection = $this->connections->connection($this->centralConnection);

        return $connection;
    }
}

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Internal;

use CoreX\Context\Contracts\TenantDatabaseProvisioner;
use CoreX\Context\Data\AccountRef;
use CoreX\Context\Data\ProvisionParams;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Internal\Jobs\CreateDatabaseFromTemplate;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Internal\Models\Account;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Contracts\TemplateIntegrityChecks;

/**
 * Persists verified provisioning parameters, then clones synchronously. Replays verify the
 * existing account database instead of cloning again.
 */
final class DatabaseTenantProvisioner implements TenantDatabaseProvisioner
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly string $centralConnection,
        private readonly TemplateIntegrityChecks $templateIntegrityVerifier,
    ) {}

    public function provision(ProvisionParams $params): void
    {
        $this->templateIntegrityVerifier->verifyCurrent(
            version: $params->templateVersion,
            clusterId: $params->clusterId,
        );

        $account = Account::on($this->centralConnection)->findOrFail($params->accountId);

        $account->forceFill([
            'cluster_id' => $params->clusterId,
            'template_version' => $params->templateVersion,
            'embedding_model' => $params->embeddingModel,
            'embedding_dim' => $params->embeddingDim,
            'vertical_code' => $params->verticalCode,
            'locale' => $params->locale,
        ])->save();

        CreateDatabaseFromTemplate::dispatchSync(
            new AccountRef($account->id, $account->slug ?? '', $account->status, [], []),
            $params,
        );
    }
}

10→# D107 — Явное claim/cleanup хранение до P08

**Actor:** owner, текущая Codex-сессия исполнения P07.2.
**Owner evidence:** Ответ владельца 2026-10-04: «Сохранить claim/cleanup в data до P08 (рекомендуется)» на вопрос о конфликте запрета `root_accounts.data` и исключения изменений схемы из P07.2.
**Sources:** phases/P07/P07.2.md, Implementation Rules; decisions/D95-p07-tenancy-engine.md §7; packages/tenancy/src/Provisioning/Internal/ClaimAccountSignup.php; packages/tenancy/src/Account/Internal/PendingPool.php.

## Solution

Уточнить запрет D95 §7 и P07.2: модели Account/Domain больше не используют vendor virtual-column, не записывают произвольные атрибуты в `data`; явные существующие SQL-операции claim/signup и очистки pending pool с `root_accounts.data` сохраняются до P08. Они обеспечивают долговечную идемпотентность signup, проверку повторного запроса и восстановление cleanup после сбоя внешнего DROP.

20→Миграции, перенос этих полей и удаление колонки остаются в P08. В P07.2 не менять эти гарантии, замороженные контракты и схему. Это точечное исключение для перечисленных существующих SQL-операций, а не разрешение нового произвольного хранения. Остальные требования P07.2, включая независимое owner-requested ревью, сохраняются.

## Why

Сохранение явного SQL-хранения исключает потерю идемпотентности и расширение P07.2 на запрещённые изменения схемы. Удаление vendor virtual-column остаётся обязательным.

## Consequences

Полный tenancy-набор и PostgreSQL-набор покрывают ClaimLifecycleConformanceTest и PendingPoolTest. Completion Notes должны явно назвать сохраняемые операции; не утверждать, что колонка вообще нигде не читается/пишется. P08 обязан перенести долговечное хранение прежде удаления колонки.

        $this->app->tag([TenancyConfigSection::class], ConfigReportSection::class);

    public function boot(): void
    {
        // root_* migrations are PG-only DDL (jsonb/CHECK/UNIQUE NULLS NOT
        // DISTINCT) targeting the CENTRAL connection, never a tenant/account
        // database (D14). Publish-only, not loadMigrationsFrom (mirrors

        $this->publishes([

        // root above; a consumer's golden-template build assembles these
        // (P2.12), never an ad hoc migrate on a live tenant connection.
        $this->publishes([
            __DIR__.'/../database/migrations/tenant' => database_path('migrations/tenant'),

        $this->publishes([
            __DIR__.'/../config/corex-tenancy.php' => config_path('corex-tenancy.php'),
        ], 'corex-tenancy-config');

        foreach ($this->registrars() as $registrar) {
            $registrar->boot($this->app);
        }
    }

    /** @return list<PackageRegistrar> */
    private function registrars(): array
    {
        $corexTenancy = $this->app['config']->get('corex-tenancy', []);
        $corexTenancy = is_array($corexTenancy) ? $corexTenancy : [];

        $registrars = [
            new RuntimeRegistrar,
            new DatabaseRegistrar,
            new ProvisioningRegistrar,
            new IdentityRegistrar,
            new WorkspaceRegistrar,
            new DomainTrustRegistrar,
            new ConsoleRegistrar,
            new HttpRegistrar,
            new EventsRegistrar,
        ];

        // validate OIDC before Testbench defineEnvironment fills issuer fields.
        $oidcEnabled = (bool) ($corexTenancy['oidc']['enabled'] ?? false);

        if ($oidcEnabled) {
            $registrars[] = new AuthenticationRegistrar;
        }

        $wakeupDriver = is_string($corexTenancy['wakeup']['driver'] ?? null)
            ? $corexTenancy['wakeup']['driver']
            : 'local_sweep';

        if (
            $wakeupDriver === 'root_registry'
            && interface_exists(WakeupScheduleHint::class)
            && interface_exists(DueWakeupSweeper::class)
        ) {
            $registrars[] = new WakeupRegistrar;
        }

        return $registrars;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Internal;

use CoreX\Tenancy\Contracts\ProvisioningClaim;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Contracts\TemplateIntegrityVerifier;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Data\ClaimRequest;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Data\ClaimResult;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Data\QualifiedTemplate;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Exceptions\ClaimConflict;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Exceptions\ClaimUnavailable;
use Illuminate\Database\Connection;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;

/** @internal */
final class ClaimAccountSignup implements ProvisioningClaim
{
    private const string SignupKeyIndex = 'root_accounts_signup_key_uq';

    private const int MaxTransactionAttempts = 3;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly string $centralConnection,
        private readonly TemplateIntegrityVerifier $templateIntegrity,
        private readonly ConnectionResolverInterface $connections,
    ) {}

    public function claim(ClaimRequest $request): ClaimResult
    {
        $this->validateRequest($request);

        for ($attempt = 1; $attempt <= self::MaxTransactionAttempts; $attempt++) {
            try {
                return $this->connection()->transaction(
                    callback: fn (): ClaimResult => $this->claimInTransaction($request),
                    attempts: 1,
                );
            } catch (QueryException $exception) {
                if ($this->isNamedSignupKeyViolation($exception)) {
                    continue;
                }

                if (! $this->isRetryableTransactionFailure($exception) || $attempt === self::MaxTransactionAttempts) {
                    throw $exception;
                }
            }
        }

        throw new ClaimUnavailable('The signup claim could not be reconciled.');
    }

    private function claimInTransaction(ClaimRequest $request): ClaimResult
    {
        $connection = $this->connection();

        $connection->select(
            query: 'SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(CAST(? AS bigint))',
            bindings: [$this->advisoryLockId($request->requestKey)],
        );

        $bindings = $connection->table('root_accounts')
            ->select(['id', 'status', 'deleted_at', 'data'])
            ->whereRaw("data->>'signup_key' = ?", [$request->requestKey])
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->lock('FOR UPDATE')
            ->get();

        if ($bindings->count() > 1) {
            throw new ClaimConflict('The signup key has ambiguous account bindings.');
        }

        if ($bindings->count() === 1) {
            return $this->replayResult($bindings->first(), $request);
        }

        $qualifiedTemplate = $this->templateIntegrity->qualify($request);
        $this->validateQualifiedTemplate($qualifiedTemplate, $request);
        $this->lockAndVerifyTemplate($connection, $qualifiedTemplate);

        $candidate = $connection->table('root_accounts')
            ->select(['id', 'cluster_id', 'template_version', 'embedding_model', 'embedding_dim', 'data'])
            ->where('cluster_id', $request->clusterId)
            ->where('template_version', $qualifiedTemplate->templateVersion)
            ->where('status', 'pending')
            ->whereNull('deleted_at')
            ->whereJsonDoesntContainKey('data->signup_key')
            ->whereJsonDoesntContainKey('data->signup_request_digest')
            ->whereJsonDoesntContainKey('data->signup_cluster_id')
            ->whereJsonDoesntContainKey('data->signup_template_id')
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->lock('FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED')
            ->first();

        if ($candidate === null) {
            throw new ClaimUnavailable('No qualified pending account is available.');
        }

        $payload = json_encode([
            'signup_key' => $request->requestKey,
            'signup_request_digest' => $request->requestDigest,
            'signup_cluster_id' => $request->clusterId,
            'signup_template_id' => $request->templateId,
        ], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

        $updated = $connection->update(
            query: "UPDATE root_accounts
                SET status = ?, data = data || ?::jsonb, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                WHERE id = ?
                  AND status = 'pending'
                  AND deleted_at IS NULL
                  AND NOT jsonb_exists(data, 'signup_key')
                  AND NOT jsonb_exists(data, 'signup_request_digest')
                  AND NOT jsonb_exists(data, 'signup_cluster_id')
                  AND NOT jsonb_exists(data, 'signup_template_id')",
            bindings: ['provisioning', $payload, $candidate->id],
        );

        if ($updated !== 1) {
            throw new ClaimUnavailable('The pending account changed before reservation.');
        }

        return new ClaimResult(accountId: $candidate->id, replayed: false);
    }

    private function replayResult(object $binding, ClaimRequest $request): ClaimResult
    {
        $data = json_decode($binding->data, true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

        if (! is_array($data)
            || $binding->deleted_at !== null
            || $binding->status === 'deleted'
            || ($data['signup_key'] ?? null) !== $request->requestKey
            || ($data['signup_request_digest'] ?? null) !== $request->requestDigest
            || ($data['signup_cluster_id'] ?? null) !== $request->clusterId
            || ($data['signup_template_id'] ?? null) !== $request->templateId) {
            throw new ClaimConflict('The signup key is already bound to a different request.');
        }

        return new ClaimResult(accountId: $binding->id, replayed: true);
    }

    private function lockAndVerifyTemplate(Connection $connection, QualifiedTemplate $qualifiedTemplate): void
    {
        $cluster = $connection->table('root_clusters')
            ->where('id', $qualifiedTemplate->clusterId)
            ->where('status', 'active')
            ->where('template_version', $qualifiedTemplate->templateVersion)
            ->lock('FOR UPDATE')
            ->first(['id']);

        $template = $connection->table('root_templates')
            ->where('id', $qualifiedTemplate->templateId)
            ->where('version', $qualifiedTemplate->templateVersion)
            ->where('status', 'ready')
            ->lock('FOR UPDATE')
            ->first(['id']);

        if ($cluster === null || $template === null) {
            throw new ClaimUnavailable('The qualified template is no longer current.');
        }
    }

    private function validateRequest(ClaimRequest $request): void
    {
        if (preg_match('/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$/D', $request->requestKey) !== 1) {
            throw new ClaimConflict('The signup key is invalid.');
        }

        if (! $this->isCanonicalUuid($request->clusterId) || ! $this->isCanonicalUuid($request->templateId)) {
            throw new ClaimConflict('The cluster and template identifiers must be canonical UUIDs.');
        }

        if (preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/D', $request->requestDigest) !== 1) {
            throw new ClaimConflict('The request digest is invalid.');
        }
    }

    private function validateQualifiedTemplate(QualifiedTemplate $qualifiedTemplate, ClaimRequest $request): void
    {
        if ($qualifiedTemplate->clusterId !== $request->clusterId
            || $qualifiedTemplate->templateId !== $request->templateId
            || $qualifiedTemplate->templateVersion < 1
            || preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/D', $qualifiedTemplate->artifactDigest) !== 1) {
            throw new ClaimUnavailable('The template proof does not match the request.');
        }
    }

    private function advisoryLockId(string $requestKey): string
    {
        $bytes = substr(hash('sha256', "corex:signup:v1:{$requestKey}", binary: true), 0, 8);

        return (string) unpack('q', strrev($bytes))[1];
    }

    private function isCanonicalUuid(string $value): bool
    {
        return preg_match('/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/D', $value) === 1;
    }

    private function isNamedSignupKeyViolation(QueryException $exception): bool
    {
        return $this->sqlState($exception) === '23505'
            && str_contains($exception->getMessage(), self::SignupKeyIndex);
    }

    private function isRetryableTransactionFailure(QueryException $exception): bool
    {
        return in_array($this->sqlState($exception), ['40001', '40P01'], strict: true);
    }

    private function sqlState(QueryException $exception): ?string
    {
        $previous = $exception->getPrevious();

        return $previous?->getCode() ?: null;
    }

    private function connection(): Connection
    {
        /** @var Connection */
        $connection = $this->connections->connection($this->centralConnection);

        return $connection;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal;

use CoreX\Tenancy\DomainTrust\Data\NormalizedHost;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\TenancyOptions;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Exceptions\TenantCouldNotBeIdentifiedByHostException;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Cache\Factory as CacheFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;

/**
 * Resolves `Request::getHost()` to an account id through `root_domains` (verified, not deleted)
 * and `root_accounts` (not deleted, slug set — §7.3 п.9: a pending shell has neither a verified
 * domain nor a slug, so it is unreachable by host). The cache holds the account id only and
 * never a miss; it lives in the explicit host store, outside the tenant cache stores.
 */
final readonly class HostAccountResolver
{
    public function __construct(
        private ConnectionResolverInterface $connections,
        private CacheFactory $cache,
        private TenancyOptions $options,
    ) {}

    /** @return string account id */
    public function resolve(string $host): string
    {
        $host = self::normalizeHost($host);
        $store = $this->cache->store($this->options->hostCacheStore);
        $id = $this->options->hostCache ? $store->get(self::key($host)) : null;

        if (! is_string($id)) {
            $id = $this->lookup($host);

            if ($id !== null && $this->options->hostCache) {
                $store->put(self::key($host), $id, $this->options->hostCacheTtl);
            }
        }

        return $id ?? throw TenantCouldNotBeIdentifiedByHostException::forHost($host);
    }

    public static function key(string $host): string
    {
        return 'corex-tenancy:host:'.$host;
    }

    public static function normalizeHost(string $host): string
    {
        try {
            return (new NormalizedHost($host))->value;
        } catch (InvalidArgumentException) {
            throw TenantCouldNotBeIdentifiedByHostException::forHost($host);
        }
    }

    private function lookup(string $host): ?string
    {
        $id = $this->connections->connection($this->options->centralConnection)
            ->table('root_domains as d')
            ->join('root_accounts as a', 'a.id', '=', 'd.account_id')
            ->whereRaw('lower(d.host) = ?', [$host])
            ->whereNull('d.deleted_at')
            ->whereNotNull('d.verified_at')
            ->whereNull('a.deleted_at')
            ->whereNotNull('a.slug')
            ->value('d.account_id');

        return is_string($id) ? $id : null;
    }
}

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Internal\Database;

use CoreX\Tenancy\Contracts\TemplateIntegrityVerifier as TemplateIntegrityVerifierContract;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\TenancyOptions;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Contracts\TemplateIntegrityChecks;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Data\ClaimRequest;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Data\QualifiedTemplate;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Data\TemplateAccountView;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Exceptions\TemplateIntegrityException;
use Illuminate\Database\Connection;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use Illuminate\Database\Connectors\ConnectionFactory;

/** @internal */
final class TemplateIntegrityVerifier implements TemplateIntegrityChecks, TemplateIntegrityVerifierContract
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly string $centralConnection,
        private readonly SchemaCatalogueSerializer $serializer,
        private readonly TemplateIntegrityLock $lock,
        private readonly TenancyOptions $options,
        private readonly ConnectionResolverInterface $connections,
        private readonly ConnectionFactory $connectionFactory,
    ) {}

    public function qualify(ClaimRequest $request): QualifiedTemplate
    {
        $template = $this->verify(templateId: $request->templateId, version: null, clusterId: $request->clusterId);

        return new QualifiedTemplate(
            clusterId: $request->clusterId,
            templateId: (string) $template->id,
            templateVersion: (int) $template->version,
            artifactDigest: $this->manifestFor((string) $template->id)->digest($this->serializer),
        );
    }

    public function verifyCurrent(int $version, ?string $clusterId = null): void
    {
        $this->assertCurrent($version, $clusterId);
    }

    public function verifyAccount(TemplateAccountView $account): void
    {
        $this->assertAccount((object) [
            'template_version' => $account->templateVersion,
            'cluster_id' => $account->clusterId,
            'db_name' => $account->databaseName,
        ]);
    }

    public function assertCurrent(int $version, ?string $clusterId = null): object
    {
        return $this->verify(templateId: null, version: $version, clusterId: $clusterId);
    }

    public function assertAccount(object $account): object
    {
        $template = $this->assertCurrent(
            version: (int) $account->template_version,
            clusterId: (string) $account->cluster_id,
        );
        $actualHash = $this->actualHashForDatabase((string) $account->db_name);

        if ($actualHash !== $template->schema_hash) {
            throw new TemplateIntegrityException('The account database no longer matches its trusted template schema.');
        }

        return $template;
    }

    private function verify(?string $templateId, ?int $version, ?string $clusterId): object
    {
        $connection = $this->db();

        return $connection->transaction(function () use ($connection, $templateId, $version, $clusterId): object {
            $query = $connection->table('root_templates')->where('status', 'ready')->lockForUpdate();

            if ($templateId !== null) {
                $query->where('id', $templateId);
            }

            if ($version !== null) {
                $query->where('version', $version);
            }
            $template = $query->first();

            if ($template === null || ! is_string($template->schema_hash)) {
                throw new TemplateIntegrityException('The requested template has no trusted schema hash.');
            }

            $this->lock->acquire($connection, (string) $template->id);

            if ($clusterId !== null && ! $connection->table('root_clusters')
                ->where('id', $clusterId)->where('status', 'active')->where('template_version', $template->version)->exists()) {
                throw new TemplateIntegrityException('The cluster does not currently admit this template.');
            }

            $manifest = $this->manifestFor((string) $template->id);
            $manifest->assertTrusted(
                trustedKeys: $this->tenancyOptions()->templateIntegrityTrustedKeys,
                serializer: $this->serializer,
            );
            $actualHash = $this->actualHash($template);
            $manifest->assertMatches(template: $template, actualHash: $actualHash);

            return $template;
        });
    }

    private function actualHash(object $template): string
    {
        return $this->actualHashForDatabase((string) $template->db_name);
    }

use CoreX\Attributes\Api;
use InvalidArgumentException;

#[Api(since: '1.0')]
final readonly class NormalizedHost
{
    public string $value;

    public function __construct(string $host)
    {
        if ($host === '' || $host !== trim($host) || str_contains($host, ':') || str_ends_with($host, '.')) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Host must be an unambiguous DNS hostname.');
        }

        $normalized = strtolower($host);

        if (! mb_check_encoding($normalized, 'ASCII') || strlen($normalized) > 253 || $normalized === 'localhost') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Host must be a non-reserved ASCII hostname.');
        }

        $labels = explode('.', $normalized);

        if (count($labels) < 2 || array_any($labels, static fn (string $label): bool => preg_match('/^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$/', $label) !== 1)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Host must contain valid DNS labels.');
        }

        $this->value = $normalized;
    }

    public function __toString(): string
    {
        return $this->value;
    }
}

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel;

use CoreX\Attributes\Spi;
use CoreX\Attributes\SpiKind;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\AccountConnectionResolver;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\TenancyManager;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\TenantContextResolver;

use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Internal\Database\TemplateClonePostgreSQLManager;

use Override;

#[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]
final class RuntimeRegistrar implements PackageRegistrar
{
    #[Override]
    public function register(Application $app): void
    {
        // Lazy singleton, never instance(): materializing TenancyOptions here would
        // validate OIDC before Testbench fills it; the provider resolves it in boot().
        $app->singleton(
            TenancyOptions::class,
            static fn (Application $app): TenancyOptions => TenancyOptions::fromArray(
                config: self::tenancySection($app),
            ),
        );
        $app->bind(
            ImpersonationPolicy::class,
            static fn (Application $app): ImpersonationPolicy => $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->impersonation,
        );
        $app->bind(
            AccountLifecyclePolicy::class,
            static fn (Application $app): AccountLifecyclePolicy => $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->lifecycle,
        );
        $app->bind(
            StatusGatePolicy::class,
            static fn (Application $app): StatusGatePolicy => $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->statusGate,
        );

        $app->singleton(
            FrameworkConfig::class,
            static fn (): FrameworkConfig => TenancyRuntimeFactory::frameworkConfig(),
        );

        $app->bindIf(
            AccountConnectionResolver::class,
            static fn (Application $app): AccountConnectionResolver => new CentralTemplateConnectionResolver(
                connections: $app->make(ConnectionResolverInterface::class),
                config: $app->make(FrameworkConfig::class),
                centralConnection: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->centralConnection,
            ),
        );

        $app->singleton(
            ConnectionBootstrapper::class,
            static fn (Application $app): ConnectionBootstrapper => new ConnectionBootstrapper(
                databases: $app->make(DatabaseManager::class),
                config: $app->make(FrameworkConfig::class),
                centralConnection: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->centralConnection,
            ),
        );
        $app->singleton(
            CachePrefixBootstrapper::class,
            static fn (Application $app): CachePrefixBootstrapper => new CachePrefixBootstrapper(
                cache: $app->make(CacheManager::class),
                config: $app->make(FrameworkConfig::class),
                stores: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->cacheStores,
                prefix: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->cachePrefix,
                centralConnection: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->centralConnection,
            ),
        );
        $app->singleton(
            SessionConnectionBootstrapper::class,
            static fn (Application $app): SessionConnectionBootstrapper => new SessionConnectionBootstrapper(
                sessions: $app->make(SessionManager::class),
                cache: $app->make(CacheManager::class),
                container: $app,
                config: $app->make(FrameworkConfig::class),
                centralConnection: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->centralConnection,
                files: $app->make('files'),
            ),
        );

        $app->singleton(
            DatabaseTenancyManager::class,
            static fn (Application $app): DatabaseTenancyManager => TenancyRuntimeFactory::manager($app),
        );
        $app->singleton(
            TenancyManager::class,
            static fn (Application $app): DatabaseTenancyManager => $app->make(DatabaseTenancyManager::class),
        );
        $app->singleton(
            QueueTenantContext::class,
            static fn (Application $app): QueueTenantContext => new QueueTenantContext(
                manager: $app->make(TenancyManager::class),
                accounts: $app->make(AccountRead::class),
                workspaceResolver: TenancyRuntimeFactory::workspaceResolver(),
                centralConnection: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->centralConnection,
            ),
        );
        $app->singleton(TenantContextResolver::class, TenancyManagerContextResolver::class);
        $app->extend(
            TenantContextRestorer::class,
            static fn (TenantContextRestorer $semantic, Application $app): ConnectionGuardedTenantContextRestorer => new ConnectionGuardedTenantContextRestorer(
                semantic: $semantic,
                database: $app->make(DatabaseManager::class),
            ),
        );

        $app->scoped(
            TenantStorage::class,
            static fn (Application $app): ContextTenantStorage => new ContextTenantStorage(
                contexts: $app->make(TenantContextResolver::class),
                filesystems: new FilesystemManager($app),
                durableDriver: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->storageDurableDriver,
                durableRoot: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->storageDurableRoot,
                ephemeralRoot: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->storageEphemeralRoot,
            ),
        );

        $app->bind(
            TemplateClonePostgreSQLManager::class,
            static fn (Application $app): TemplateClonePostgreSQLManager => new TemplateClonePostgreSQLManager(
                options: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class),
                connections: $app->make(ConnectionResolverInterface::class),
                integrity: $app->make(TemplateIntegrityVerifier::class),
            ),
        );
    }

    #[Override]
    public function boot(Application $app): void
    {
        $app->make(QueueManager::class)->createPayloadUsing(TenancyRuntimeFactory::payloadHook());
    }

    /**
     * `cache_stores = null` means the application's default cache store: the secure default is to
     * isolate what the application actually uses.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private static function tenancySection(Application $app): array
    {
        $section = self::configSection($app, 'corex-tenancy');

        if (($section['cache_stores'] ?? null) === null) {
            $default = TenancyRuntimeFactory::frameworkConfig()->get('cache.default');
            $section['cache_stores'] = is_string($default) && $default !== '' ? [$default] : [];
        }

        return $section;
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    private static function configSection(Application $app, string $key): array
    {
        $section = $app['config']->get($key, []);

        if (! is_array($section)) {
            return [];
        }

        return array_filter($section, static fn (mixed $key): bool => is_string($key), ARRAY_FILTER_USE_KEY);
    }
}
