use Illuminate\Contracts\Events\Dispatcher;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use Illuminate\Database\Connectors\ConnectionFactory;
use Override;
use Psr\Clock\ClockInterface;

#[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]
final class ProvisioningRegistrar implements PackageRegistrar
{
    use RegistersNothingOnBoot;

    #[Override]
    public function register(Application $app): void
    {
        $app->singleton(
            DatabaseTenantProvisioner::class,
            static fn (Application $app): DatabaseTenantProvisioner => new DatabaseTenantProvisioner(
                centralConnection: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->centralConnection,
                templateIntegrityVerifier: $app->make(TemplateIntegrityVerifier::class),
            ),
        );

        $app->singleton(
            PendingPool::class,
            static fn (Application $app): PendingPool => new PendingPool(
                centralConnection: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->centralConnection,
                provisioner: $app->make(DatabaseTenantProvisioner::class),
                templateIntegrityVerifier: $app->make(TemplateIntegrityVerifier::class),
                connections: $app->make(ConnectionResolverInterface::class),
            ),
        );

        $app->singleton(
            DatabaseTenantLifecycle::class,
            static fn (Application $app): DatabaseTenantLifecycle => new DatabaseTenantLifecycle(
                centralConnection: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->centralConnection,
                connections: $app->make(ConnectionResolverInterface::class),
                clock: $app->make(ClockInterface::class),
                events: $app->make(Dispatcher::class),
            ),
        );
        $app->singleton(
            TenantDatabaseLifecycle::class,
            static fn (Application $app): DatabaseTenantLifecycle => $app->make(
                DatabaseTenantLifecycle::class,
            ),
        );

        $app->scoped(
            AccountLifecycle::class,
            static fn (Application $app): AccountLifecycle => new AccountLifecycle(
                centralConnection: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->centralConnection,
                pendingPool: $app->make(PendingPool::class),
                fsm: $app->make(AccountLifecycleFsm::class),
                tenantDatabaseLifecycle: $app->make(TenantDatabaseLifecycle::class),
                impersonationGuard: $app->make(ImpersonationGuard::class),
                templateIntegrityVerifier: $app->make(TemplateIntegrityVerifier::class),
                lifecycle: $app->make(AccountLifecyclePolicy::class),
                connections: $app->make(ConnectionResolverInterface::class),
                clock: $app->make(ClockInterface::class),
                events: $app->make(Dispatcher::class),
                connectionFactory: $app->make(ConnectionFactory::class),
                hostCache: $app->make(HostResolverCacheInvalidator::class),
            ),
        );

        $app->singleton(
            MigrationWaveOrchestrator::class,
            static fn (Application $app): MigrationWaveOrchestrator => new MigrationWaveOrchestrator(
                centralConnection: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->centralConnection,
                tenancy: $app->make(TenancyManager::class),
                templateIntegrityVerifier: $app->make(TemplateIntegrityVerifier::class),
            ),
        );
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\DomainTrust\Internal;

use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Contracts\DomainChallengeStore;
use CoreX\Tenancy\DomainTrust\Data\DomainChallengeBinding;
use CoreX\Tenancy\DomainTrust\Data\DomainTrustTransition;
use CoreX\Tenancy\DomainTrust\Data\NormalizedHost;
use CoreX\Tenancy\DomainTrust\Data\ObservedDomainProof;
use CoreX\Tenancy\DomainTrust\Enums\DomainTrustChangeReason;
use CoreX\Tenancy\DomainTrust\Events\DomainTrustChanged;
use CoreX\Tenancy\DomainTrust\Exceptions\DomainTrustDenied;
use CoreX\Tenancy\DomainTrust\Internal\Models\Domain;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Events\Dispatcher;
use Illuminate\Database\Connection;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Psr\Clock\ClockInterface;
use Throwable;

final class DomainTrustStateWriter
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ConnectionResolverInterface $connections,
        private readonly ClockInterface $clock,
        private readonly Dispatcher $events,
        private readonly string $centralConnection,
    ) {}

    public function generationFor(string $accountId, NormalizedHost $host): int
    {
        $domain = $this->domains()
            ->whereRaw(sql: 'lower(host) = ?', bindings: [$host->value])
            ->whereNull(columns: 'deleted_at')
            ->first();

        if ($domain === null) {
            return 0;
        }

        if ($domain->account_id !== $accountId) {
            throw new DomainTrustDenied('The host belongs to another account.');
        }

        return $domain->verification_generation;
    }

    public function verify(string $accountId, NormalizedHost $host, DomainChallengeStore $challengeStore, ObservedDomainProof $proof): DomainTrustTransition
    {
        try {
            $transition = $this->connection()->transaction(callback: function () use ($accountId, $host, $challengeStore, $proof): DomainTrustTransition {
                $domain = $this->lockedDomain($host);

                if ($domain !== null && $domain->account_id !== $accountId) {
                    throw new DomainTrustDenied('The host belongs to another account.');
                }

                if ($domain !== null && $domain->verified_at !== null) {
                    throw new DomainTrustDenied('The host is already trusted.');
                }

                $oldGeneration = $domain === null ? 0 : $domain->verification_generation;
                $consumption = $challengeStore->consumeMatching(
                    binding: new DomainChallengeBinding(accountId: $accountId, host: $host, generation: $oldGeneration),
                    proof: $proof,
                );

                if (! $consumption->consumed) {
                    throw new DomainTrustDenied('The ownership proof was rejected.');
                }

                $occurredAt = $this->clock->now();
                $domain ??= new Domain([
                    'id' => (string) Str::uuid7(),
                    'account_id' => $accountId,
                    'host' => $host->value,
                    'type' => 'custom',
                    'is_primary' => false,
                    'tls_status' => 'none',
                ]);
                $domain->setConnection($this->centralConnection);
                $domain->verified_at = CarbonImmutable::instance($occurredAt);
                $domain->verification_generation = $oldGeneration + 1;
                $this->saveDomain($domain);

                return new DomainTrustTransition(
                    accountId: $accountId,
                    host: $host,
                    oldGeneration: $oldGeneration,
                    newGeneration: $domain->verification_generation,
                    reason: DomainTrustChangeReason::Verified,
                    occurredAt: $occurredAt,
                );
            });
        } catch (QueryException $exception) {
            throw new DomainTrustDenied(message: 'The host could not be claimed.', previous: $exception);
        }

        $this->dispatchChange($transition);

        return $transition;
    }

    public function revoke(string $accountId, NormalizedHost $host): DomainTrustTransition
    {
        $transition = $this->connection()->transaction(callback: function () use ($accountId, $host): DomainTrustTransition {
            $domain = $this->lockedDomain($host);

            if ($domain === null || $domain->account_id !== $accountId) {
                throw new DomainTrustDenied('The host is not owned by this account.');
            }

            $occurredAt = $this->clock->now();
            $oldGeneration = $domain->verification_generation;
            $domain->verified_at = null;
            $domain->verification_generation = $oldGeneration + 1;
            $this->saveDomain($domain);

            return new DomainTrustTransition(
                accountId: $accountId,
                host: $host,
                oldGeneration: $oldGeneration,
                newGeneration: $domain->verification_generation,
                reason: DomainTrustChangeReason::Revoked,
                occurredAt: $occurredAt,
            );
        });

        $this->dispatchChange($transition);

        return $transition;
    }

    public function reassign(string $fromAccountId, string $toAccountId, NormalizedHost $host): DomainTrustTransition
    {
        $transition = $this->connection()->transaction(callback: function () use ($fromAccountId, $toAccountId, $host): DomainTrustTransition {
            $domain = $this->lockedDomain($host);

            if ($domain === null || $domain->account_id !== $fromAccountId) {
                throw new DomainTrustDenied('The host is not owned by the source account.');
            }

            $occurredAt = $this->clock->now();
            $oldGeneration = $domain->verification_generation;
            $domain->verified_at = null;
            $domain->account_id = $toAccountId;
            $domain->verification_generation = $oldGeneration + 1;
            $this->saveDomain($domain);

            return new DomainTrustTransition(
                accountId: $toAccountId,
                host: $host,
                oldGeneration: $oldGeneration,
                newGeneration: $domain->verification_generation,
                reason: DomainTrustChangeReason::Reassigned,
                occurredAt: $occurredAt,
            );
        });

        $this->dispatchChange($transition);

        return $transition;
    }

    private function connection(): Connection
    {
        /** @var Connection */
        $connection = $this->connections->connection(name: $this->centralConnection);

        return $connection;
    }

    /** @return Builder<Domain> */
    private function domains(): Builder
    {
        return Domain::on(connection: $this->centralConnection);
    }

    private function lockedDomain(NormalizedHost $host): ?Domain
    {
        return $this->domains()
            ->whereRaw(sql: 'lower(host) = ?', bindings: [$host->value])
            ->whereNull(columns: 'deleted_at')
            ->lockForUpdate()
            ->first();
    }

    private function dispatchChange(DomainTrustTransition $transition): void
    {
        $this->connection()->afterCommit(
            callback: fn (): mixed => $this->events->dispatch(new DomainTrustChanged(transition: $transition)),
        );
    }

    private function saveDomain(Domain $domain): void
    {
        try {
            $domain->save();
        } catch (Throwable $exception) {
            throw new DomainTrustDenied(message: 'Trusted state could not be made current.', previous: $exception);
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Internal\Lifecycle;

use Closure;
use CoreX\Audit\Contracts\CurrentActor;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\ImpersonationGuard;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\TenantDatabaseLifecycle;
use CoreX\Context\Data\AccountRef;
use CoreX\Context\Enums\ImpersonationRestrictedAction;
use CoreX\Messaging\Events\DomainEvent;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Events\AccountSuspended;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Events\GraceStarted;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Events\TrialStarted;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Internal\Models\Account;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Internal\PendingPool;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\AccountLifecyclePolicy;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\HostResolverCacheInvalidator;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Contracts\TemplateIntegrityChecks as TemplateIntegrityVerifier;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Data\TemplateAccountView;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Events\Dispatcher;
use Illuminate\Database\Connection;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use Illuminate\Database\Connectors\ConnectionFactory;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Psr\Clock\ClockInterface;
use RuntimeException;

/**
 * The account FSM (B-11 §5.1/§5.2, P2.12) — `root_accounts.status` MUST be
 * mutated ONLY through this class. Every transition writes one
 * `root_account_events` row ({@see writeEvent()}); the transitions that own
 * a dedicated {@see DomainEvent} subclass also fire it
 * (`startTrial`→TrialStarted, `suspend`→AccountSuspended,
 * `startGrace`→GraceStarted; `AccountPurged`/`ExportReady` are fired by
 * {@see CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Internal\DatabaseTenantLifecycle}, not
 * here — see that class's docblock). `activate()`/`resume()`/
 * `requestExport()` have no dedicated event class in this item's scope
 * (Files list, P2.12) — they still write a `root_account_events` row.
 *
 * D151 — every mutating method asserts {@see ImpersonationGuard} first
 * (before `activateFromPool`'s pool claim only, per that method's own
 * ordering note).
 *
 * @internal
 */
final class AccountLifecycle
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly string $centralConnection,
        private readonly PendingPool $pendingPool,
        private readonly AccountLifecycleFsm $fsm,
        private readonly TenantDatabaseLifecycle $tenantDatabaseLifecycle,
        private readonly ImpersonationGuard $impersonationGuard,
        private readonly TemplateIntegrityVerifier $templateIntegrityVerifier,
        private readonly AccountLifecyclePolicy $lifecycle,
        private readonly ConnectionResolverInterface $connections,
        private readonly ClockInterface $clock,
        private readonly Dispatcher $events,
        private readonly ConnectionFactory $connectionFactory,
        private readonly HostResolverCacheInvalidator $hostCache,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Claims a pending-pool row (premortem A6 — atomic via
     * {@see PendingPool::pullPending()}'s own `SELECT … FOR UPDATE SKIP
     * LOCKED`), then races-safely claims it for THIS caller with a
     * `WHERE status='provisioning'`-guarded update, then transitions
     * `provisioning → trial` via {@see startTrial()} (AC-13 platform
     * domain).
     */
    public function activateFromPool(string $slug, string $ownerIdentityId, ?string $vertical): AccountRef
    {
        $this->impersonationGuard->assertAllowed(ImpersonationRestrictedAction::DeleteAccount);

        $claimed = $this->pendingPool->pullPending();

        $affected = $this->db()->transaction(fn (): int => $this->db()
            ->table('root_accounts')
            ->where('id', $claimed->id)
            ->where('status', 'provisioning')
            ->update([
                'slug' => $slug,
                'owner_identity_id' => $ownerIdentityId,
                'vertical_code' => $vertical,
                'updated_at' => $this->clock->now(),
            ]));

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Internal;

use CoreX\Context\Data\ProvisionParams;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Internal\Models\Account;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Contracts\TemplateIntegrityChecks;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Data\TemplateAccountView;
use DateTimeInterface;
use Illuminate\Database\Connection;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use LogicException;
use RuntimeException;

/**
 * Pending-pool mechanics (B-11 §5.2, AC-4/AC-5): keeps `pending_pool_size`
 * pre-cloned account databases per cell so signup never waits on
 * `CREATE DATABASE … TEMPLATE` (p95 < 3с). Pending болванки carry
 * `status='pending'`, `slug`/`owner_identity_id` NULL — the frozen
 * DB_SCHEMA table-CHECK on `root_accounts` already allows that state
 * (D14/P2.2), so no `pending_since` column is needed: `status` alone encodes "not yet claimed".
 *
 * Claiming (premortem A6): {@see pullPending()} flips `status`
 * `pending → provisioning` inside a `SELECT … FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`
 * transaction — two concurrent callers never claim the same row. `slug`/
 * `owner_identity_id` stay NULL: the full pending→active transition (slug,
 * owner, status=trial) is P2.12's `AccountLifecycle::activateFromPool`
 * (Scope Excluded) — this class only reserves the row and lays the
 * atomicity invariant for that later transition.
 */
final class PendingPool
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly string $centralConnection,
        private readonly DatabaseTenantProvisioner $provisioner,
        private readonly TemplateIntegrityChecks $templateIntegrityVerifier,
        private readonly ConnectionResolverInterface $connections,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Create $count pending болванки on $clusterId (least-loaded active
     * cluster per call if omitted), cloning each database synchronously
     * from the cell's current ready template (D24 parity gate).
     *
     * @return list<string> created account ids
     */
    public function createPending(int $count, ?string $clusterId = null): array
    {
        $created = [];

        for ($i = 0; $i < $count; $i++) {
            $created[] = $this->cloneOne($clusterId, 'pending');
        }

        return $created;
    }

    /**
     * Number of pending (unclaimed) болванки, optionally scoped to one
     * cluster — used by the pending-create command to top up to
     * `root_clusters.pending_pool_size`.
     */
    public function pendingCount(?string $clusterId = null): int
    {
        $query = $this->db()
            ->table('root_accounts')
            ->where('status', 'pending');

        if ($clusterId !== null) {
            $query->where('cluster_id', $clusterId);
        }

        return $query->count();
    }

    /**
     * Claim a pending account from the least-loaded cell (`ORDER BY
     * db_count`); an empty pool falls back to a synchronous clone
     * (< 10с, AC-5).
     */
    public function pullPending(): Account
    {
        $claimedId = $this->db()->transaction(function (): ?string {
            $candidate = $this->db()
                ->table('root_accounts as ra')
                ->join('root_clusters as rc', 'rc.id', '=', 'ra.cluster_id')
                ->where('ra.status', 'pending')
                ->orderBy('rc.db_count')
                ->select('ra.id')
                ->lock('for update of ra skip locked')
                ->first();

            if ($candidate === null) {
                return null;
            }

            $account = Account::on($this->centralConnection)->findOrFail($candidate->id);

            if (! $account instanceof Account) {
                throw new LogicException('Expected a pending account.');
            }
            $this->templateIntegrityVerifier->verifyAccount(new TemplateAccountView($account->template_version, $account->cluster_id, $account->db_name));

            $this->db()
                ->table('root_accounts')
                ->where('id', $candidate->id)
                ->update(['status' => 'provisioning']);

            return $candidate->id;
        });

        $id = $claimedId ?? $this->cloneOne(null, 'provisioning');

        return Account::on($this->centralConnection)->findOrFail($id);
    }

    /**
     * Delete stale pending болванки — DROP DATABASE + DELETE root_accounts
     * — either by `template_version` (schema drifted from a new golden
     * template) and/or by age (`created_at` older than $olderThan). At
     * least one filter is required: an unfiltered clear would nuke the
     * whole pool.
     *
     * @return int number of болванки cleared
     */
    public function clearPending(?int $templateVersion = null, ?DateTimeInterface $olderThan = null): int
    {
        if ($templateVersion === null && $olderThan === null) {
            throw new RuntimeException('pending-clear requires --template-version and/or --older-than.');
        }

        if ($this->db()->transactionLevel() !== 0) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Pending cleanup must run outside a transaction.');
        }

        $query = $this->db()
            ->table('root_accounts')
            ->where(fn ($query) => $query->where('status', 'pending')
                ->orWhere(fn ($query) => $query->where('status', 'provisioning')->where('data->pool_cleanup', true)));

        if ($templateVersion !== null) {
            $query->where('template_version', $templateVersion);
        }

        if ($olderThan !== null) {
            $query->where('created_at', '<', $olderThan);
        }

        $stale = $query->get(['id', 'db_name', 'cluster_id']);
        $cleared = 0;

        foreach ($stale as $row) {
            // A committed claim removes the row from signup selection before external DDL.
            // The marker makes a failed DROP recoverable by the next cleanup run.
            $claimed = $this->db()->table('root_accounts')
                ->where('id', $row->id)
                ->where(fn ($query) => $query->where('status', 'pending')
                    ->orWhere(fn ($query) => $query->where('status', 'provisioning')->where('data->pool_cleanup', true)))
                ->update(['status' => 'provisioning', 'data' => $this->db()->raw("jsonb_set(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(data) = 'object' THEN data ELSE '{}'::jsonb END, '{pool_cleanup}', 'true')")]);

            if ($claimed !== 1) {
                continue;
            }

            $this->db()->statement('DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS "'.$row->db_name.'"');

            $this->db()->transaction(function () use ($row, &$cleared): void {
                $deleted = $this->db()
                    ->table('root_accounts')
                    ->where('id', $row->id)
                    ->where('status', 'provisioning')
                    ->where('data->pool_cleanup', true)
                    ->delete();

                if ($deleted === 0) {
                    return;
                }

                $this->db()
                    ->table('root_clusters')
                    ->where('id', $row->cluster_id)
                    ->decrement('db_count');
                $cleared++;
            });
        }

        return $cleared;
    }

    private function cloneOne(?string $clusterId, string $status): string
    {
        $cluster = $clusterId !== null
            ? $this->clusterRow($clusterId)
            : $this->leastLoadedActiveCluster();

        $template = $this->readyTemplateFor((int) $cluster->template_version);

        $this->templateIntegrityVerifier->verifyCurrent(
            version: (int) $template->version,
            clusterId: (string) $cluster->id,
        );

        $id = (string) Str::uuid7();
        $dbName = 'acc_'.str_replace('-', '', $id);

        Account::on($this->centralConnection)->create([
            'id' => $id,
            'cluster_id' => $cluster->id,
            'db_name' => $dbName,
            'status' => 'provisioning',
            'template_version' => $template->version,
            'embedding_model' => $template->embedding_model,
            'embedding_dim' => $template->embedding_dim,
        ]);

        $this->provisioner->provision(new ProvisionParams(
            accountId: $id,
            clusterId: $cluster->id,
            templateVersion: (int) $template->version,
            embeddingModel: $template->embedding_model,
            embeddingDim: (int) $template->embedding_dim,
        ));

        $this->db()->transaction(function () use ($cluster, $id, $status): void {
            $this->db()->table('root_accounts')
                ->where('id', $id)->update(['status' => $status]);

            $this->db()
                ->table('root_clusters')
                ->where('id', $cluster->id)
                ->increment('db_count');
        });

        return $id;
    }

    private function clusterRow(string $clusterId): object
    {
        $cluster = $this->db()
            ->table('root_clusters')
            ->where('id', $clusterId)
            ->first();

        if ($cluster === null) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Cluster [{$clusterId}] not found in root_clusters.");
        }

/** Fresh Laravel connection bound to an arbitrary already-created database on the same PG server. */
function connectTo(string $database): Connection
{
    $name = 'probe_'.$database;

    config(["database.connections.{$name}" => [
        'driver' => 'pgsql',
        'host' => getenv('PGSQL_HOST') ?: '127.0.0.1',
        'port' => getenv('PGSQL_PORT') ?: '5434',
        'database' => $database,
        'username' => getenv('PGSQL_USERNAME') ?: 'corex',
        'password' => getenv('PGSQL_PASSWORD') ?: 'corex',
        'charset' => 'utf8',
        'prefix' => '',
        'schema' => 'public',
    ]]);

    DB::purge($name);

    return DB::connection($name);
}

content.text: корректно нормализуется через lowercase. Убедился, что событие domainChanged корректно обрабатывает изменение Account при сохранении домена. При soft-delete домена с записью deleted_at сброс кеша хостов работает. Обновление Account через Eloquent вызывает forgetAccount, который забирает все домены без фильтра по deleted_at — это ожидаемое поведение. Обновление Account через Query Builder в lifecycle тоже корректно использует afterCommit для сброса кеша.

Supports independent PRs, Graphite stacks, and GitHub stacked PRs (gh-stack). Optional ship lands a ready PR bottom-up when every job has passed and no comments remain open.

availableCommands.name: bundled:review
availableCommands.description: Run a reviewer subagent against your whole branch vs main, your uncommitted working state, a named branch, a single GitHub PR, or an entire Graphite/stacked-PR stack (one reviewer subagent per PR). A bare /review defaults to reviewing your uncommitted working state when the tree is dirty, or your whole branch vs main when the tree is clean. Main, local, and branch modes write a review file plus a summary to disk. PR and stack modes post the findings as a PENDING GitHub review for the user to inspect and submit through the UI. Use --main for an explicit clean-tree branch review, --stack for stacked PRs, --submit to publish immediately as COMMENT, or --approve to publish and approve; the default remains PENDING.

content.text: вне явной транзакции: `Account::create()` коммитится отдельно, а `provision()` запускает джобу позже. Поэтому

в PHP 8.1+ работает корректно, а проект требует ^8.4 — ошибки при десериализации не возникнут.

Драйвер `sync` запускает джобу мгновенно, поэтому синхронность сохраняется и спецификация соблюдается.

Но `dispatchToQueue` на подключении `sync` всё равно вызывает события Laravel и слушателей `QueueTenantContext`. Это создаёт побочный эффект: даже при синхронном выполнении джобы срабатывают обработчики контекста тенанта.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal;

use Closure;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\TenancyManager;
use CoreX\Context\Data\TenantContext;
use CoreX\Context\Data\WorkspaceRef;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Contracts\AccountRead;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Exceptions\TenantContextUnavailable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Queue\Job;
use Illuminate\Queue\Events\JobAttempted;
use Illuminate\Queue\Events\JobProcessing;
use Illuminate\Queue\Jobs\SyncJob;

/**
 * Per-job tenant context. `processing` enters the account named by the job payload
 * (`corex_tenant`); `finished` — the single completion point, dispatched from the `finally`
 * of both Worker::process and SyncQueue::executeJob — ends it. Frames are a LIFO stack keyed
 * by the job object, so a sync job (also a nested one) restores its caller's account and
 * workspace, while an async job always starts and ends central. A job whose account is
 * missing fails instead of running on the previous database.
 */
final class QueueTenantContext
{
    /** @var list<array{job: Job, previous: ?TenantContext}> */
    private array $frames = [];

    /** @param Closure(string): ?WorkspaceRef $workspaceResolver tenant query, called only after initialize */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly TenancyManager $manager,
        private readonly AccountRead $accounts,
        private readonly Closure $workspaceResolver,
        private readonly string $centralConnection,
    ) {}

    public function processing(JobProcessing $event): void
    {
        $restore = $event->job instanceof SyncJob || $this->frames !== [];
        $previous = $restore ? $this->manager->context() : null;
        $this->frames[] = ['job' => $event->job, 'previous' => $previous]; // before end/find/initialize
        $this->manager->end();

        $payload = $event->job->payload()['corex_tenant'] ?? null;

        if ($payload === null) {
            return; // central job; a sync caller is restored only after this job finished
        }

        if (! is_array($payload) || ! is_string($payload['account'] ?? null)
            || ! array_key_exists('workspace', $payload)
            || ($payload['workspace'] !== null && ! is_string($payload['workspace']))) {
            throw TenantContextUnavailable::invalidPayload();
        }

        $ref = $this->accounts->find($payload['account'], $this->centralConnection)
            ?? throw TenantContextUnavailable::missingAccount($payload['account']);
        $this->manager->initialize($ref);

        if ($payload['workspace'] !== null) {
            $workspace = ($this->workspaceResolver)($payload['workspace'])
                ?? throw TenantContextUnavailable::missingWorkspace($payload['workspace']);
            $this->manager->setWorkspace($workspace);
        }
    }

    public function finished(JobAttempted $event): void
    {
        $key = array_key_last($this->frames);

        if ($key === null || $this->frames[$key]['job'] !== $event->job) {
            return; // unrelated or repeated completion cannot pop another job's frame
        }

        $frame = $this->frames[$key];
        array_pop($this->frames);
        $this->manager->end();

        if ($frame['previous'] !== null) {
            $this->manager->initialize($frame['previous']->account);
            $this->manager->setWorkspace($frame['previous']->workspace);
        }
    }
}

availableCommands.name: google-workspace
availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.

availableCommands.name: user:docs
availableCommands.description: docs (editable docs people share and comment on; the default for any document, named as a doc or not: a document, report, proposal, resume, cover letter, letter, contract, policy, form, template, worksheet, essay, handbook, guide, how-to, cheat sheet, SOP or other writing to keep, share, collaborate on, send, submit, print or sign; a doc exports to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs, so needing a file to send, attach, upload, submit or print is no reason to pick Word, and a file nobody asked for is a doc, not Word; a plan, comparison, summary or notes asked in chat stays in chat; a pasted claude.ai artifact link may be a doc: check with docs tools first; Word or another file format named, tracked changes wanted, or a .docx to change or use as a template → that format's skill): making one → if no docs-connector instructions are in context, call its `guide` (topic.instructions) first; then create the doc (headings only, no body) before any search, file read or plan, even with files attached.

availableCommands.name: bundled:review
availableCommands.description: Run a reviewer subagent against your whole branch vs main, your uncommitted working state, a named branch, a single GitHub PR, or an entire Graphite/stacked-PR stack (one reviewer subagent per PR). A bare /review defaults to reviewing your uncommitted working state when the tree is dirty, or your whole branch vs main when the tree is clean. Main, local, and branch modes write a review file plus a summary to disk. PR and stack modes post the findings as a PENDING GitHub review for the user to inspect and submit through the UI. Use --main for an explicit clean-tree branch review, --stack for stacked PRs, --submit to publish immediately as COMMENT, or --approve to publish and approve; the default remains PENDING.

10→# D45 — P02 identifiers, config sections and completeness gate (accepted)

**Actor:** author-choice (claude-opus-5-5/high, `task:plan-design … P02`) по мандату владельца B6.
**Evidence:** RAG:— `artifacts/P02-design/facts/identifier-map.tsv` (62 строки), `php scripts/ownership-gate.php --report`, `packages/tenancy/config/tenancy.php`, `php scripts/p15-rename-completeness-gate.php` (9 нарушений на `d2e84a1`, не в CI).

## Solution

1. **Идентификаторы** (D33) — ровно `facts/identifier-map.tsv`: config-файлы `corex-auth|corex-attributes|corex-api|corex-intl-search|corex-task-recurrence` → имя пакета; `corex-modules` → раздел `corex.modules` (файл вливается в `config/corex.php` ключом `modules`); теги по префиксу пакета, `corex-api-migrations-tenant` и `corex-api-tenant-migrations` → один тег `corex-operations-migrations-tenant`, `corex-modules-migrations[-tenant]` → `corex-migrations[-tenant]`, `corex-modules-config` удаляется; команды `corex:messaging:prune-pubsub`, `corex:operations:{prune,snapshot,bulk-work}`, `corex:tenancy:{migrate,pending-create,pending-clear,reconcile-identities,wakeup-root-sweep}`; env `COREX_AUTH_*`→`COREX_ACCESS_*`, `COREX_INTL_SEARCH_ENABLED`→`COREX_SEARCH_INTL_ENABLED`, `TENANCY_*`→`COREX_TENANCY_*`. Имена маршрутов, событий, таблиц и wire не меняются (P06/P08).
2. **Config-ключ `tenancy` сохраняется до P07:** файл читает движок stancl (`tenant_model`, `id_generator`, bootstrappers); `scripts/ownership-map.json` получает `upstream_config: ["tenancy"]` для `axiomasoft/corex-tenancy`, ownership-гейт пропускает только этот ключ (негативный контроль — любой другой ключ). P07 удаляет исключение вместе с заменой движка (D13).
3. **`corex-tools` без config в P02:** в `corex-api.php` нет раздела tools; конфиг появится с typed options (P05).
20→4. **`corex:config:validate`** (D32) — SPI `CoreX\Config\Contracts\ConfigReportSection` с `order()`: ядро 0, tenancy 10, access 20, modules 25, media 30, intl 40, search 50, search-meilisearch 60. Команда выводит drivers → adapters → secrets разделов по `order()`; вывод полного монорепо побайтно равен текущему (регрессионный тест в корневом `tests/`).
5. **Компилятор реестра** (D32) — SPI `CoreX\Modules\Contracts\ManifestSectionCompiler` (`mode()`, `phase()`, `compile()`, `normalize()`); тексты `CompilationException` сохраняются; декларация режима без зарегистрированного компилятора — `CompilationException('No compiler for API declaration mode: <mode>')`.
6. **Гейт полноты переименований** — `scripts/rename-completeness-gate.php` + `scripts/rename-completeness.json` (генерирует `p02-transfer.py manifest` до переноса): точные FQCN, префиксы исчезающих корней glossary, composer-имена, пути, идентификаторы; исключения — `plans/`, `audits/`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/history/`, `docs/architecture/rename-registry.md`, `tests/Golden/rename-map.json`, сам манифест. Устаревший `scripts/p15-rename-completeness-gate.php` (+ манифест, composer-скрипт) удаляется: он красный на `main`, не подключён к CI и запрещает `CoreX\Data\DataScopeAccessDecision`, который D29 делает каноническим.

## Why

- D33/N7: идентификатор определяет пакет; ownership `--strict` = 0 — критерий закрытия P02 (D39).
- Порядок разделов сохраняет наблюдаемый вывод команды при инверсии зависимости (D32 «без изменения поведения»).
- Отклонено: переименовать `tenancy` сейчас — сломало бы чтение конфигурации движком до P07; сохранить P15-гейт — он противоречит D29 и уже не исполняется.

30→## Consequences

P02.1 (config sections, compiler SPI), P02.4 (идентификаторы, гейт, ownership strict, CI); P07 снимает `upstream_config`.

## Solution

1. **Идентификаторы** (D33) — ровно `facts/identifier-map.tsv`: config-файлы `corex-auth|corex-attributes|corex-api|corex-intl-search|corex-task-recurrence` → имя пакета; `corex-modules` → раздел `corex.modules` (файл вливается в `config/corex.php` ключом `modules`); теги по префиксу пакета, `corex-api-migrations-tenant` и `corex-api-tenant-migrations` → один тег `corex-operations-migrations-tenant`, `corex-modules-migrations[-tenant]` → `corex-migrations[-tenant]`, `corex-modules-config` удаляется; команды `corex:messaging:prune-pubsub`, `corex:operations:{prune,snapshot,bulk-work}`, `corex:tenancy:{migrate,pending-create,pending-clear,reconcile-identities,wakeup-root-sweep}`; env `COREX_AUTH_*`→`COREX_ACCESS_*`, `COREX_INTL_SEARCH_ENABLED`→`COREX_SEARCH_INTL_ENABLED`, `TENANCY_*`→`COREX_TENANCY_*`. Имена маршрутов, событий, таблиц и wire не меняются (P06/P08).
2. **Config-ключ `tenancy` сохраняется до P07:** файл читает движок stancl (`tenant_model`, `id_generator`, bootstrappers); `scripts/ownership-map.json` получает `upstream_config: ["tenancy"]` для `axiomasoft/corex-tenancy`, ownership-гейт пропускает только этот ключ (негативный контроль — любой другой ключ). P07 удаляет исключение вместе с заменой движка (D13).
3. **`corex-tools` без config в P02:** в `corex-api.php` нет раздела tools; конфиг появится с typed options (P05).
20→4. **`corex:config:validate`** (D32) — SPI `CoreX\Config\Contracts\ConfigReportSection` с `order()`: ядро 0, tenancy 10, access 20, modules 25, media 30, intl 40, search 50, search-meilisearch 60. Команда выводит drivers → adapters → secrets разделов по `order()`; вывод полного монорепо побайтно равен текущему (регрессионный тест в корневом `tests/`).
5. **Компилятор реестра** (D32) — SPI `CoreX\Modules\Contracts\ManifestSectionCompiler` (`mode()`, `phase()`, `compile()`, `normalize()`); тексты `CompilationException` сохраняются; декларация режима без зарегистрированного компилятора — `CompilationException('No compiler for API declaration mode: <mode>')`.
6. **Гейт полноты переименований** — `scripts/rename-completeness-gate.php` + `scripts/rename-completeness.json` (генерирует `p02-transfer.py manifest` до переноса): точные FQCN, префиксы исчезающих корней glossary, composer-имена, пути, идентификаторы; исключения — `plans/`, `audits/`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/history/`, `docs/architecture/rename-registry.md`, `tests/Golden/rename-map.json`, сам манифест. Устаревший `scripts/p15-rename-completeness-gate.php` (+ манифест, composer-скрипт) удаляется: он красный на `main`, не подключён к CI и запрещает `CoreX\Data\DataScopeAccessDecision`, который D29 делает каноническим.

## Why

- D33/N7: идентификатор определяет пакет; ownership `--strict` = 0 — критерий закрытия P02 (D39).
- Порядок разделов сохраняет наблюдаемый вывод команды при инверсии зависимости (D32 «без изменения поведения»).
- Отклонено: переименовать `tenancy` сейчас — сломало бы чтение конфигурации движком до P07; сохранить P15-гейт — он противоречит D29 и уже не исполняется.

30→## Consequences

P02.1 (config sections, compiler SPI), P02.4 (идентификаторы, гейт, ownership strict, CI); P07 снимает `upstream_config`.

1→# Changelog

## Unreleased — PLAN3.P07.2 (D95/D98; pre-1.0 BC delta)

- Removed Stancl and its prerelease provider dependencies, runtime model projections, identifier binding,
  JobPipeline wiring and the obsolete PHPStan import rule. Account/Domain are plain central Eloquent models;
  Account uses UUIDv7, explicit fillable columns and immutable date/integer casts. The legacy data column is unused.
- Configuration moves from `tenancy` to `corex-tenancy`, including wakeup, under one published file. Removed
  tenantModel/idGenerator/tenantDatabaseManager/provisioningPipeline options; `TenancyOptions::fromArray()`
10→  now accepts one configuration array. Middleware aliases and route/error identifiers retain their existing names.
- `AccountTemplateSnapshot::capture()` now accepts AccountRef and the explicit central connection. Provisioning
  synchronously runs CreateDatabaseFromTemplate with AccountRef/ProvisionParams; template integrity, replay
  verification, WAL_LOG cloning, export-before-drop and cache invalidation are preserved.

## Unreleased — thin providers and registrars (P05.2)

### PLAN3.P07.1 — own tenancy engine (BC delta, unpublished; D95, D98, D100–D103)

- **Added:** `Runtime\Contracts\TenantBootstrapper` (SPI), `Runtime\Events\TenantContextInitialized` / `TenantContextEnded`,
20→  `Runtime\Exceptions\TenantContextUnavailable` (`tenancy.context_unavailable`, `TenancyErrorCode::ContextUnavailable`),
  `Http\Middleware\ScopeSessionToTenant`, `Support\HostResolverCacheInvalidator`; internal `DatabaseTenancyManager` with
  connection / cache-prefix / session bootstrappers, per-job `QueueTenantContext`, `HostAccountResolver`.
- **Semantics:** every context switch (`initialize`, `end`, leaving `runFor`) forgets the container's scoped instances (the scope
  boundary is the tenant boundary); a failed revert poisons the runtime; queue payloads carry `corex_tenant` and `JobAttempted` is
  the single completion point; sessions are bound to the account (first binding invalidates earlier attributes; mismatch → 403).
- **Changed (BC):** `AccountStatusGate::__construct()` takes five required arguments (policy, `TenantContextResolver`,
  `AccountRead`, `AuthFactory`, central connection); `ResolveTenantFromHost` is a plain middleware (no stancl base class, new
  constructor) and ends the context after the response; `TenancyOptions` gains `bootstrappers`, `cacheStores`, `hostCache*`
  (replacing `bootstrapperOrder` and `hostIdentificationCache*`); `TenantCouldNotBeIdentifiedByHostException` no longer extends a
30→  stancl exception.
- **Configuration / security:** config key `tenancy.bootstrapper_order` → `tenancy.bootstrappers`; new `tenancy.cache_stores`
  (null = the default cache store; only redis, memcached, database and file stores are supported, `array`/`null`/`failover` are
  refused); the host cache store must be outside `cache_stores`; tenant HTTP sessions support the `database`, `redis`,
  `memcached` and `file` drivers (redis/memcached need a dedicated `session.store`), other drivers are refused before the first
  switch.
- **Removed:** `Bootstrappers\WorkspaceContextBootstrapper`, `Resolvers\HostTenantResolver`,
  `Listeners\RevertTenancyOnJobException`; the stancl provider is no longer discovered (`extra.laravel.dont-discover`).


40→- Registrar closures with several statements moved to named methods; behaviour is unchanged.

Это minor, а не major.

Проверка механизма

ли их для FINDINGS.

Проверка Account::getConnectionName
риск: если createPayloadUsing случайно добавит corex_tenant

TemplateClonePostgreSQLManager явно использует центральную связь, поэтому основной риск — не переключение на tenant-базу, а падение провижинга. Если createPayloadUsing добавит corex_tenant в payload при активном tenant-контексте, processing() вызовет initialize(), который попытается подключиться к ещё несозданной базе и выбросит исключение. Клонирование базы не произойдёт. Это сильный баг, если dispatchSync проходит через очередь, createPayloadUsing добавляет corex_tenant, а провижинг запускается в tenant-контексте.

1→# axiomasoft/corex-tenancy

Laravel tenancy primitives for CoreX's physical PostgreSQL database-per-account
profile.

## Optional wakeup root hints

`corex-tenancy.wakeup.driver` defaults to `local_sweep`. With `axiomasoft/corex-wakeup` installed, a cloud
deployment may explicitly select `root_registry`; this enables the advisory `root_wakeup_hints`
10→table and the `corex:tenancy:wakeup-root-sweep` command. Hints never replace a tenant-local request or
provide authority to select an account connection.

## Package engine and configuration

CoreX owns the account/domain models, physical tenancy engine and synchronous golden-template
provisioning. Account identifiers use UUIDv7; account fields are explicit typed columns. The legacy
`root_accounts.data` column is unused. Saved/deleting model events invalidate the central host cache.

Publish configuration with `php artisan vendor:publish --tag=corex-tenancy-config`. All settings,
20→including wakeup, use `config/corex-tenancy.php` under `corex-tenancy`. Migrate host overrides from the
previous `tenancy` key; the old key and model/provider configuration knobs have been removed.

## Template integrity

The internal verifier accepts a ready template only when it has all of the
following:

- a lowercase SHA-256 `schema_hash` recorded in `root_templates`;
- a configured Ed25519-signed manifest from a configured trusted key; and
30→- a matching canonical, read-only PostgreSQL catalogue hash.

`corex-tenancy.template_integrity.trusted_keys` and
`corex-tenancy.template_integrity.manifests` are deliberately empty defaults.
Existing ready rows with a NULL hash are not compatible fallback templates.
Consumer write-path adoption is intentionally separate. Operational rollback
preserves the integrity metadata; the additive migration has no destructive
automatic down action.

## Compatibility evidence
40→
The factual compatibility passport, its local proof class, and explicit limits
are in [PACKAGE.md](PACKAGE.md). It does not extend Composer constraints or
constitute a publication promise.

## Installation

Install with `composer require axiomasoft/corex-tenancy`. Prepare PostgreSQL root and physical account databases with separate trusted connection configuration. Apply each schema only to its declared owner connection; provider discovery is not permission to migrate a customer database.

## Extension contracts
50→
Applications supply the exported workspace resolution, domain trust/authorization, provisioning and template integrity ports for their deployment. Compose optional wakeup through its declared adapter. Account connection selection must come from authenticated trusted context, never unvalidated request fields.

## Failure semantics

An untrusted or incomplete tenant context must not select an account database. Template provisioning refuses missing/mismatched hashes, manifests and signatures. A failed provisioning claim requires reconciliation of durable state before retry; optional advisory wakeup hints never authorize a connection switch.

## Typed errors

Package error identities use backed enums and a boot compiled kernel registry.
60→Error constructors require `ErrorCode`; descriptors keep scoped string wire codes.
See the monorepo [error contract](../../docs/reference/errors.md) for contributions,
validated replay and safe mapping.

availableCommands.name: long-running-background-tasks

availableCommands.name: bundled:review
availableCommands.description: Run a reviewer subagent against your whole branch vs main, your uncommitted working state, a named branch, a single GitHub PR, or an entire Graphite/stacked-PR stack (one reviewer subagent per PR). A bare /review defaults to reviewing your uncommitted working state when the tree is dirty, or your whole branch vs main when the tree is clean. Main, local, and branch modes write a review file plus a summary to disk. PR and stack modes post the findings as a PENDING GitHub review for the user to inspect and submit through the UI. Use --main for an explicit clean-tree branch review, --stack for stacked PRs, --submit to publish immediately as COMMENT, or --approve to publish and approve; the default remains PENDING.

availableCommands.name: find-skills
availableCommands.description: Use when the user explicitly asks to find, compare, or install an agent skill. Ordinary how-to or implementation requests do not activate this skill.

availableCommands.name: setup-writing-style
availableCommands.description: Learns how the user writes from their own sent messages and docs, and builds a voice profile so future drafts sound like them instead of generic AI. The profile is saved as the my-writing-style skill. Use when the user asks to set up, learn, or capture their writing voice, or complains that drafts sound generic or unlike them and no my-writing-style profile exists. Only for drafting text the user will send as themselves, not for Claude's own replies.

availableCommands.name: import-memory
availableCommands.description: Import a memory export from another AI assistant into Claude's memory — conversationally, additively, and with the content treated as data.

availableCommands.name: morning
availableCommands.description: Render the user's morning brief as a styled HTML artifact, or set it up as a recurring weekday task. Use only when the user explicitly asks to run, see, or set up their morning brief, or if they invoke /morning by name. A question about their day, schedule, or calendar is not by itself a request for the brief; answer it directly instead.

availableCommands.name: google-workspace
availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.

availableCommands.name: user:docs
availableCommands.description: docs (editable docs people share and comment on; the default for any document, named as a doc or not: a document, report, proposal, resume, cover letter, letter, contract, policy, form, template, worksheet, essay, handbook, guide, how-to, cheat sheet, SOP or other writing to keep, share, collaborate on, send, submit, print or sign; a doc exports to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs, so needing a file to send, attach, upload, submit or print is no reason to pick Word, and a file nobody asked for is a doc, not Word; a plan, comparison, summary or notes asked in chat stays in chat; a pasted claude.ai artifact link may be a doc: check with docs tools first; Word or another file format named, tracked changes wanted, or a .docx to change or use as a template → that format's skill): making one → if no docs-connector instructions are in context, call its `guide` (topic.instructions) first; then create the doc (headings only, no body) before any search, file read or plan, even with files attached.
